programme.title: House of Gucci / House of Gucci
programme.desc: In 1978, Patrizia Reggiani, an outsider of humble origins, met Maurizio Gucci. After she seduces him, they marry and Patricia becomes part of the famous Gucci family. When she becomes pregnant, she hopes to bury the unrest within the family. But Patricia's unbridled ambition leads the Gucci family into the abyss: betrayal, decadence, revenge and murder ensue. / Im Jahr 1978 trifft Patrizia Reggiani, eine AuSSenstehende von bescheidener Herkunft, Maurizio Gucci. Nachdem sie ihn verfuhrt hat, heiraten sie, und Patricia wird ein Teil der beruhmten Gucci-Familie. Als sie schwanger wird, hofft sie, damit die Unruhen innerhalb der Familie zu begraben. Doch Patricias zugelloser Ehrgeiz fuhrt die Gucci-Familie in den Abgrund: Es kommt zu Verrat, Dekadenz, Rache und Mord.

programme.title: Soccer FIFA World Cup 2026 Qualification Highlights / FuSSball FIFA WM 2026 Qualifikation Highlights
programme.desc: The highlights of the FIFA World Cup 2026 qualification. / Die Highlights der FIFA WM 2026 Qualifikation.

programme.title: The Last Duel / The Last Duel
programme.desc: When the beautiful Marguerite de Carrouges, the wife of the knight Jean de Carrouges, accuses the squire Jacques Le Gris of raping her, her husband brings the accusation to King Charles the Sixth. The king decides that a duel is the only way to resolve the men's dispute. The fight becomes the last legal duel in the history of France and leads to the uncovering of a conspiracy. / Als die schone Marguerite de Carrouges, die Ehefrau des Ritters Jean de Carrouges, den Knappen Jacques Le Gris beschuldigt, sie vergewaltigt zu haben, tragt ihr Mann den Vorwurf Konig Charles dem Sechsten vor. Der Konig entscheidet, dass ein Duell der einzige Weg ist, um den Streit der Manner zu schlichten. Der Kampf wird das letzte legale Duell in der Geschichte Frankreichs und fuhrt zur Aufdeckung einer Verschworung.

programme.title: 9-1-1 Emergency Call L.A. / 9-1-1 Notruf L.A.
programme.desc: The series follows police officers, paramedics and firefighters in their everyday work. Among other things, it describes the experiences of first aiders who regularly experience unpredictable and heartbreaking situations. / Die Serie begleitet Polizisten, Rettungssanitater und Feuerwehrleute im Arbeitsalltag. Es werden unter anderem Erfahrungen der Ersthelfer geschildert, die regelmaSSig unvorhersehbare und herzzerreiSSende Situationen erleben.

programme.title: Scrubs - The Beginners / Scrubs - Die Anfanger
programme.desc: From the perspective of the young doctor J.D. The chaotic and bizarre everyday hospital life at Sacred Heart Hospital is told. Together with his friends Turk, Elliot and Carla, he overcomes all the challenges of an aspiring doctor. / Aus der Perspektive des Jungmediziners J.D. wird der chaotische und bizarre Krankenhausalltag aus dem Sacred Heart Hospital erzahlt. Gemeinsam mit seinen Freunden Turk, Elliot und Carla meistert er alle Herausforderungen eines angehenden Arztes.

programme.title: ZIB Zack Mini / ZIB Zack Mini
programme.desc: The program conveys connections and backgrounds for six to ten year olds every day. / Die Sendung vermittelt taglich Zusammenhange und Hintergrunde fur Sechs- bis Zehnjahrige.

programme.title: Nils Holgersson / Nils Holgersson
programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old Nils Holgersson annoys the animals on his parents' farm and also has other nasty fun. As a punishment, a gnome turns him into a dwarf, and the innocent hamster Krumel is not spared either. / Der vierzehnjahrige Nils Holgersson argert die Tiere auf dem elterlichen Bauernhof und treibt auch sonst uble SpaSSe. Ein Wichtelmannchen verwandelt ihn zur Strafe in einen Zwerg, und auch der unschuldige Hamster Krumel bleibt nicht verschont.

programme.title: The hunt for the Kju Wang / Die Jagd nach dem Kju Wang
programme.desc: The city of Venice, inhabited by birds, is ruled by a powerful duke. This duke owns a valuable gemstone, the Kju-Wang, which symbolizes his power. The ambassador of a foreign country wants to steal the Kju-Wang. / Die Stadt Venedig, die von Vogeln bewohnt wird, wird von einem machtigen Herzog regiert. Dieser Herzog besitzt einen wertvollen Edelstein den Kju-Wang, der seine Macht symbolisiert. Der Botschafter eines fremden Landes will den Kju-Wang stehlen.

programme.title: Hello Kasperl / Servus Kasperl
programme.sub-title: Kasperl and Hopsi: Burillo und Theresa
programme.desc: The show presents painting competitions, birthday greetings and stories with Punch and Judy. / Die Sendung prasentiert Malwettbewerbe, GeburtstagsgruSSe und Geschichten mit dem Kasperl.

programme.title: The miracle YOU / Das Wunder DU
programme.desc: The children's program deals with scientific topics relating to the human body. / Die Kindersendung befasst sich mit wissenschaftlichen Themen rund um den menschlichen Korper.

programme.title: Great animals / Tolle Tiere
programme.desc: Kurt the cat goes on a journey through the Schonbrunn Zoo. It introduces native and exotic wild animals as well as popular and unusual pets. As zoo helpers, two children also experience working with the zoo animals up close. / Kater Kurt begibt sich auf eine Reise durch den Tiergarten Schonbrunn. Er stellt heimische und exotische Wildtiere sowie beliebte und ungewohnliche Haustiere vor. Als Zoohelfer erleben zwei Kinder zudem hautnah die Arbeit mit den Zootieren.

programme.title: Barbapapa and family / Barbapapa und Familie
programme.desc: Barbapapa, Barbamama and their seven children can change objects and things with their will. Using this power, the nine go on many different fun and exciting adventures around the world. / Barbapapa, Barbamama und ihre sieben Kinder konnen Gegenstande und Dinge mit ihrem Willen verandern. Mithilfe dieser Kraft begeben sich die neun auf viele verschiedene lustige und spannende Abenteuer rund um den Erdball.

programme.title: Garfield / Garfield
programme.desc: Garfield, the world's laziest cat, is back and has more fun adventures. Garfield's quirky misadventures here are generally rougher and more bizarre than in the past. / Garfield, der faulste Kater der Welt ist zuruck und erlebt noch mehr witzige Abenteuer. Dabei fallen Garfields schrullige Missgeschicke hier in der Regel derber und bizarrer aus als in der Vergangenheit.

programme.title: ZIB Zack Mini / ZIB Zack Mini
programme.desc: The program conveys connections and backgrounds for six to ten year olds every day. / Die Sendung vermittelt taglich Zusammenhange und Hintergrunde fur Sechs- bis Zehnjahrige.

programme.title: Malcolm in the middle / Malcolm mittendrin
programme.desc: A gifted child has to deal with his eccentric family. The Cleavers are a middle-class American family with a chaotic everyday life. Little Malcom uses his intelligence to plan pranks with his brothers. / Ein hochbegabtes Kind muss mit seiner exzentrischen Familie umgehen. Die Cleavers sind eine mittelstandische US-Familie mit chaotischem Alltagsleben. Der kleine Malcom nutzt seine Intelligenz, um mit seinen Brudern Streiche auszuhecken.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to run a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police force. From now on he investigates here with Inspector Lars Englen. / Finn Kiesewetter hat den Polizeidienst verlassen, um einen Bauernhof zu fuhren. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.title: Smart10 - The quiz with the ten possibilities / Smart10 - Das Quiz mit den zehn Moglichkeiten
programme.desc: Two teams of two compete against each other in the knowledge duel hosted by Caroline Athanasiadis. The participants have to demonstrate general knowledge, good teamwork, tactics and risk assessment in order to be successful. / Zwei Zweierteams treten im Wissensduell bei Caroline Athanasiadis gegeneinander an. Dabei mussen die Teilnehmer Allgemeinwissen, gutes Teamwork, Taktik und Risikoeinschatzung unter Beweis stellen, um erfolgreich abzuschneiden.

programme.title: Q1 One note is incorrect / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch
programme.desc: This quiz is all about clues. First, the topic of the searched term is announced. The candidates are supposed to get on the right track with the help of four clues - but only three of them are correct. / Bei diesem Quiz dreht sich alles um Hinweise. Zuerst wird das Thema des gesuchten Begriffes bekannt gegeben. Mithilfe von vier Hinweisen sollen die Kandidaten auf die richtige Spur kommen - doch nur drei davon sind richtig.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the “Jager”. This is not an easy task, because the “Jagers” are proven quiz professionals from the German national quiz team, including the German quiz master. In the first round, the candidates individually build up a game total, which they have to defend together against the “Jager” in the second round in order to advance to the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the “Jager” and defend the money they have earned so far. You must answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions correctly than the “Jager”, they win. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise / Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A gruesome violent crime occurs on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. To clear it up, London investigator Richard Poole is assigned to the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but he can't get used to the Caribbean mentality at all. This always creates entertaining situations. The meticulous suit wearer manages to solve the case together with his colleagues on site. They really want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like seafood. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk und die schwarze Witwe
programme.desc: The detective Adrian Monk quickly became a minor celebrity due to his special skills in his job. He has a photographic memory and can create a trail from even the smallest clues. However, since the death of his beloved wife Trudy in a mysterious attack, he has suffered from severe anxiety and obsessive-compulsive disorder, which led to his suspension from duty with the San Francisco Police Department. After locking himself in his apartment for three years, he finally sets up his own business as a private detective and is repeatedly asked by the police for support. With the help of his former boss Captain Leland Stottlemeyer and his personal assistant Sharona Fleming, Monk has since solved the crime that no one else can solve. / Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: SOKO Donau / SOKO Donau
programme.desc: The dedicated special commission of the Vienna Water Police investigates crimes in the greater area of ​​the Austrian capital. The criminal team's focus is on crimes that occur on and on the Danube and its tributaries. / Die engagierte Sonderkommission der Wiener Wasserschutzpolizei klart im GroSSraum der osterreichischen Hauptstadt Verbrechen auf. Der Fokus des Kriminalistenteams liegt dabei auf Straftaten, die an und auf der Donau sowie ihren Nebenflussen geschehen.

programme.title: ZIB Flash / ZIB Flash
programme.desc: This program offers a compact overview of the most important news. / Diese Sendung bietet einen kompakten Überblick uber die wichtigsten Nachrichten.

programme.title: SOKO Kitzbuhel / SOKO Kitzbuhel
programme.desc: The Tyrolean lowland with its outstanding sporting and tourist offerings is the setting for the police team led by detective Karin Kofler and her colleague Lukas Roither, who specializes in criminal psychology, and who use a lot of expertise and empathy to put a stop to the local criminals. The investigators are supported by Karin's father Hannes, who runs the legendary "Pochlarner Stuben" inn and is blessed with a similar criminal instinct as his daughter. And finally there is Countess Schonberg, who, with her contacts with the Kitzbühel jet set, repeatedly proves to be a valuable help to the officials. / Das Tiroler Unterland mit seinen herausragenden sportlichen und touristischen Angeboten ist der Schauplatz des Polizeiteams um Kriminalbeamtin Karin Kofler und ihrem auf Kriminalpsychologie spezialisierten Kollegen Lukas Roither, die mit viel Sachverstand und Einfuhlungsvermogen den ortlichen Verbrechern das Handwerk legen. Dabei werden die Ermittler von Karins Vater Hannes unterstutzt, der das legendare Gasthaus "Pochlarner Stuben" betreibt, und mit ahnlichem kriminalistischen Spursinn gesegnet ist wie seine Tochter. Und schlieSSlich ist da noch Grafin Schonberg, die sich mit ihren Kontakten zum Kitzbuheler Jetset immer wieder als wertvolle Hilfe fur die Beamten erweist.

programme.title: Eternal You - From the end of finitude / Eternal You - Vom Ende der Endlichkeit
programme.desc: Start-ups can create AI avatars of the deceased to comfort mourners and provide the opportunity to communicate. This creates a profound examination of the human desire for immortality and the ethical questions that arise from the commercialization of this technology. The possibility of saying goodbye and finding consolation contrasts with the question of who this innovation ultimately serves and who the biggest beneficiaries are. / Start-ups konnen KI-Avatare von Verstorbenen kreieren, um Trauernden Trost zu spenden und die Moglichkeit zur Kommunikation zu bieten. Daraus entsteht eine tiefgreifende Auseinandersetzung mit dem menschlichen Verlangen nach Unsterblichkeit und den ethischen Fragen, die sich aus der Kommerzialisierung dieser Technologie ergeben. Die Moglichkeit, Abschied zu nehmen und Trost zu finden, steht im Kontrast zu der Frage, wem diese Innovation letztendlich dient und wer die groSSten Profiteure sind.

programme.desc: When the well-known writer Victor from Paris dies under mysterious circumstances, a biographer becomes interested in the life of the deceased. Kurzerhand bittet er die Witwe Sarah, ihm Einblick in die gemeinsame Beziehung zu geben. Diese ist uber 40 turbulente Jahre lang mit dem Autor zusammen gewesen. Zuletzt gilt Sarah in der Öffentlichkeit als Victors stutzende Kraft wahrend seines kunstlerischen Schaffungsprozesses, doch sie offenbart ein bitteres Geheimnis.

programme.title: Among us / Unter uns
programme.desc: The eventful everyday life of several generations takes place in Kolner Schillerallee 10, a residential and commercial building in the Ehrenfeld district. Starting from the Weigel family's bakery and pastry shop, the stories of friendship, love, intrigue and shattered dreams begin. The focus is on the Weigel family, who run a pastry shop on the ground floor and have three generations living in the house. Different families move in and out of the house on Schillerallee, and the young residents of the attic in particular change often. / In der Kolner Schillerallee 10, einem Wohn- und Geschaftshaus im Stadtteil Ehrenfeld, findet das ereignisreiche Alltagsleben mehrerer Generationen statt. Ausgehend von der Backerei und Konditorei der Familie Weigel nehmen die Geschichten um Freundschaft, Liebe, Intrigen und geplatzte Traume ihren Lauf. Dabei steht die Familie Weigel, die eine Konditorei im Erdgeschoss betreibt und mit drei Generationen im Haus lebt, im Mittelpunkt. Unterschiedliche Familien ziehen in das Haus in der Schillerallee ein und aus, vor allem die jungen Bewohner des Dachgeschosses wechseln oft.

programme.title: The Yoga Magazine / Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all this in the living room at home - the “Yoga Magazine” makes it possible. Competent and friendly yoga trainers show the best exercises for switching off. By the way, the program doesn't just report from the television studio. The programs are often recorded in a very special location - for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: “We move Austria” school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: The fun of sport and exercise is the main focus at WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH School. The aim of the ORF initiative is to reach students and teachers digitally with short exercise units and to have these take place every day in Austrian classrooms. Neither a gym nor sports clothing or special equipment are necessary. As an uncomplicated, daily exercise program for the classroom, WE BEWEGEN AUSTRIA wants to inspire schools to get more exercise and a healthy and balanced lifestyle. At the start of the expansion of the WE MOVE AUSTRIA initiative to the school sector, 30 episodes, each lasting six to eight minutes, with tailor-made exercises for everyday school life in the classroom are available. The focus is on strength, skill, coordination and relaxation in order to be able to better cope with the often stressful school day. The movement units are presented by qualified sports teacher Karin Augeneder. / Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. programme.title: Persona / Persona
programme.desc: The Person series is a Turkish criminal drama from 2018. in the director of the Sayplace, which in magnificent way connects the true tragedy and absurdity of life, and the test of existence puts moral values. The story is followed by a retired Judge and the widower Aga, which was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that will soon forget everything, that from his personality and value will not remain nothing, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skillfully dragged himself under the hands of the law. He goes into a vengeful campaign, and the task of revealing who turns the dirtiest souls and minds of Istanbul the inspection nevers, which has been a jailer in their own living. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will join their strengths? How terrible will be the network of secrets, death of witnesses and forgets? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. programme.title: Beauty UFC 10 / MMA UFC 10
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Boks / Boks
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Martial arts - mma / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Handball - Ehf European League / Rukomet - EHF Europska liga
programme.desc: EHF Cup How else by importance, competition for male handball clubs in Europe begins in 1993. years. Until then, this competition was called the IHF Cup that did its first season in the 1981-1982 season. Since 2012. The EHF Cup was connected by a former EHF Cup Cup Cup Cup. The competition as well as the Champions League consists of part where clubs play by groups and the best passes into the "Knock Out" phase. After the quarterfinals in two matches between the opponent, Sylad "Final Four". Semifinals and finals, as well as a match for a third place, are played on a single match. / EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. Do tada se ovo takmičenje nazivalo IHF kup koje je svoju prvu sezonu odradilo u sezoni 1981.-1982. Od 2012. godine EHF kupu je priključen nekadašnji EHF Kup pobjednika kupova. Takmičenje se kao i Liga šampiona sastoji od dela gdje klubovi igraju po grupama i najbolji prolazi u "knock out" fazu. Nakon četvrtfinala na dvije utakmice između protivnika sijledi "final four". Polufinale i finale, kao i utakmica za treće mjesto, igraju se na jednu dobijenu utakmicu.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Qualifications for SP 2026 / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: American Football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world's NFL was founded in 1920. years, but only by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, today's version of the competition was created. 32 teams divided into two conferences in the league. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams conferences enter the playoffs to the big final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The aim of this league to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the final tournament of the best four or popularly called Final for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.desc: 2. The ABA league is the second degree of the regional basketball ABA league. Krka New place is the historical first winner of the ABA 2. Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: NHL / NHL
programme.desc: "NATONAL HOCKEY LEAGUE" is the most prestigious club hockey competition that dates back to 1917. when the competition was formed and functioned with two more North American hockey stars. Since 1926. NHL becomes the main and most significant hockey association and thus competition in North America. Only the competition is divided into two divisions, western and east and after regular part plays the Pleffeus for the Trophy Stanley Cup. / "Natonal Hockey League" je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svijetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dvije sjevernoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podijeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dijela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Bike - Tur Lombardy (M) / Biciklizam - Tur Lombardije (M)
programme.desc: The race through Lombard is the last in a series of five monumental classics in the World Cycling Union calendar. Release of cyclists will ride from bergamers to Komo, 243 kilometers long. / Trka kroz Lombardiju poslednja je u nizu od pet monumentalnih klasika u kalendaru Svetske biciklističke unije. Na 113. izdanju biciklisti će voziti od Bergama do Komoa, rutom dugačkom 243 kilometara.

programme.desc: The World Championship in Sports Climbing for men is held in Seoul. Enjoy the performances of the best competitors from all over the world that fight for a place on the winning stand, but also valuable cash prizes. / U Seulu se održava Svetsko prvenstvo u sportskom penjanju za muškarce. Uživajte u nastupima najboljih takmičara iz celog sveta koji se bore za mesto na pobedničkom postolju, ali i vredne novčane nagrade.

programme.title: Grit and Glory Enduro Mountain Bike Racing / Grit and Glory Enduro Mountain Bike Racing
programme.desc: Documentary program on top athletes competing within the elite cycling competition. Meet the cyclists that train hard to achieve the best possible result and learn that they face all challenges on the path to success. / Dokumentarni program o vrhunskim sportiste koji se takmiče u okviru elitnog biciklističkog takmičenja. Upoznajte bicikliste koji vredno treniraju kako bi ostvarili što bolji rezultat i saznajte sa kojim se svim izazovima suočavaju na putu ka uspehu.

programme.title: Cycling: Pro -Paris Tours (M) series / Biciklizam: Serija PRO - Pariz Tours (M)
programme.desc: Paris-Tour is a one-day cycling race that is held every October from the suburbs of Paris to the Cathedral in the city of Tour. / Pariz-Tur je jednodnevna biciklistička trka koja se održava svakog oktobra od predgrađa Pariza pa do katedrale u gradu Tur.

programme.title: Snuker: Xian Grand Prix / Snuker: Xian Grand Prix
programme.desc: Follow the exciting competition in the Snuker whose host is the Chinese city of Siana. The first edition of this competition was held in 2024. years, and participants fight for the best possible placement and conquest of valuable cash prizes. / Pratite uzbudljivo takmičenje u snukeru čiji je domaćin kineski grad Sijan. Prvo izdanje ovog takmičenja je održano 2024. godine, a učesnici se bore za što bolji plasman i osvajanje vrednih novčanih nagrada.

programme.title: Superpotier / Superpotjera
programme.desc: In the superfluous hunters, the hunters are joined by a super team _ five top connoisseurs who act as one. Creating one of the most powerful quiz teams in the world, they are ready to deal with every challenger. Who among the competitors has enough knowledge, skills and concentrations to defeat this invincible team? / U Superpotjeri lovci se udružuju u super tim _ petero vrhunskih znalaca koji djeluju kao jedan. Stvorivši jednu od najmoćnijih kvizaških ekipa na svijetu, spremni su suočiti se sa svakim izazivačem. Tko među natjecateljima ima dovoljno znanja, vještine i koncentracije da pobijedi ovaj nepobjedivi tim?

programme.title: Respect / Respect
programme.desc: A biographical music film is accompanied by American singer's life, Arethe Franklin, from her childhood when she sang in a choir at her father's church to her rise to the status of an international superstar. It is a true story of the life path of the music icon and her effort to find herself and eventually become Queen Soul. / Biografski glazbeni film prati život američke pjevačice Arethe Franklin, od djetinjstva kad je kao djevojčica pjevala u zboru u očevoj crkvi pa do njezina uspona do statusa međunarodne superzvijezde. To je istinita priča o životnom putu glazbene ikone i njezinom nastojanju da pronađe sebe i na koncu postane kraljica soula.

programme.title: Diary 3 / Dnevnik 3
programme.desc: The latest news from the country and the world and a concise weather forecast for the next day. / Najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta te sažeta vremenska prognoza za sljedeći dan.

programme.title: Culture news / Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: Culture news is followed daily events from different areas of culture and art. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Glory kills / Slava ubija
programme.desc: On Wednesday, April 20, 2016, Dr. Michael Schulenberg gives Prince therapy because of the symptoms of the abstinence crisis. On the same evening, Prince's representative contacts California specialist in Dr. Howard Kornfeld's addiction disease. He is asked to help Prince, who suffers from heavy dependence on opioids. Dr. Kornfeld cannot come immediately and therefore send his son Andrew. Andrew Kornfeld and longtime Prince's friends Kirk Johnson and Meron Kekura come to Paisley Park the next day to look for Prince. To his horror, he finds his lifeless body on the elevator floor. Prince never saved. He always did his best. His life was like a party, but fun doesn't last forever. / U srijedu, 20. travnja 2016., dr. Michael Schulenberg daje Princeu terapiju zbog simptoma apstinencijske krize. Iste večeri Princeov predstavnik kontaktira kalifornijskog specijalista za bolesti ovisnosti dr. Howarda Kornfelda. Od njega se traži da pomogne Princeu, koji pati od teške ovisnosti o opioidima. Dr. Kornfeld ne može odmah doći i zato šalje svog sina Andrewa. Andrew Kornfeld te dugogodišnji Princeovi prijatelji Kirk Johnson i Meron Kekure sutradan dolaze u Paisley Park potražiti Princea. Na svoj užas, nalaze njegovo beživotno tijelo na podu dizala. Prince se nikad nije štedio. Uvijek je davao sve od sebe. Njegov je život bio poput zabave, ali zabave ne traju vječno.

programme.title: The highway of death / Autocesta smrti
programme.desc: Casey Stein (N. Hoult) agrees to steal a cocaine shipment for his former boss (B. Kingsley) so that he could pay a transplant to his girlfriend Juliette (F. Jones). Unfortunately, the drug belongs to Hagen Kahlu (A. Hopkins), the most powerful German king of the drug. Kahl of revenge abducts Juliette and sends his men for Stein. The race begins with a time where Casey desperately tries to save the woman he loves ... / Casey Stein (N. Hoult) pristaje ukrasti pošiljku kokaina za svog bivšeg šefa (B. Kingsley) kako bi mogao platiti transplantaciju svojoj djevojci Juliette (F. Jones). Nažalost, droga pripada Hagenu Kahlu (A. Hopkins), najmoćnijem njemačkom kralju droge. Kahl iz osvete otme Juliette i šalje svoje ljude za Steinom. Počinje utrka s vremenom u kojoj Casey očajnički pokušava spasiti ženu koju voli...

programme.title: The fruits of the earth / Plodovi zemlje
programme.desc: The Sunday show on agriculture and fisheries deals with current topics, critically speaks of agrarian policy, advises and teaches viewers and brings agroprognosis. The oldest specialized show of Croatian Television has been aired since 1958. / Nedjeljna emisija o poljoprivredi i ribarstvu bavi se aktualnim temama, kritički progovara o agrarnoj politici, savjetuje i poučava gledatelje te donosi agroprognozu. Najstarija specijalizirana emisija Hrvatske televizije, emitira se od 1958. godine.

programme.title: Sundays at two / Nedjeljom u dva
programme.desc: The guest of the show on Sundays at 2 is Dusko Ilijevic, "Stricek Dusko", a educator at a kindergarten in Zagreb. Based on the 20-year experience of working with children, they will explain why she thinks today's parents are too indulgent and how to set the boundaries in their daily lives for children. Empathy, climbing the trees, jumping on the mud and using a cell phone are some of the topics of the show that talks about raising children. / Gost emisije Nedjeljom u 2 je Duško Ilijević, "striček Duško", odgajatelj u jednom zagrebačkom dječjem vrtiću. Na temelju 20-godišnjeg iskustva rada s djecom objasnit će zašto misli da su današnji roditelji previše popustljivi i kako djeci postaviti granice u svakodnevnom životu. Empatija, penjanje po drveću, skakanje po blatu i upotreba mobitela neke su od tema emisije u kojoj se govori o odgoju djece.

programme.title: Witness to reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people have given their face to a small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man gets off the stage of his life, his story disappears into oblivion. They say some stories existed to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of the memory of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres were preserved in the HRT archives, signed by director Drazen Piskoric. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. / U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života.

programme.title: Culture news / Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: Culture news is followed daily events from different areas of culture and art. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: A sketch for a portrait / Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show represents the authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Positively / Pozitivno
programme.desc: Find out where it is and how the sanctuary of the Mother of God of Jerusalem was created. The artifacts, documents and books written in Glagolitic script are located in 27 countries and 90 cities. The president of the Glagolitic Friends Society Darko Žubrinić tells us about several less known interesting things related to Glagolitic. Take a peek with us in the oldest church in Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Doznajte gdje se nalazi i kako je nastalo svetište Majke Božje Jeruzalemske. Artefakti, dokumenti i knjige pisane glagoljicom nalaze se u 27 zemalja i 90 gradova. Predsjednik Društva prijatelja glagoljice Darko Žubrinić govori nam o nekoliko manje poznatih zanimljivosti vezanih za glagoljicu. Zavirite s nama u najstariju crkvu u Bosni i Hercegovini.

programme.title: Also: More / Pula: More
programme.desc: A mosaic informative issue dedicated to the richness of our Adriatic Sea, Coast and Coast. It brings interesting reports on topics related to living at sea and with it. It is broadcast from HRT studies Split, Rijeka, Zadar and Pula. / Mozaična informativna emisija posvećena bogatstvu našeg Jadranskog mora, obale i priobalja. Donosi zanimljive reportaže o temama vezanim za život na moru i uz njega. Emitira se iz HRT-ovih studija Split, Rijeka, Zadar i Pula.

programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The long -awaited amount of annual pension supplement, colloquially called the thirteenth pension, was welcomed as a cold shower for many pensioners _ Just on the International Day of the Elderly, October 1. The amount of 6 euros per year is considered as shameful, and the abolition of pension taxes _ by favoring those with the highest income. On the other hand, the Government and coalition partner of the Croatian pensioner party point out that this contributes to the improvement of the position of the elderly fellow citizens. But most of them barely survive, pensioners are testified daily. Unfortunately, there are a small number of those whose pensions exceed the average and who will feel an increase after applying a new tax policy. More than 60 percent of a total of one million and two hundred thousand retirees receive pensions lower than the average, which officially amounts to 690 euros. It will be the president of the Croatian Pensioners' Union on Monday about all this and the way of 6 euros per year of the year _ in the show on Monday on Monday, and State Secretary of State Marinko Luikned will be given. / Dugoočekivani iznos godišnjeg dodatka na mirovinu, kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina, dočekan je kao hladan tuš za mnoge umirovljenike _ upravo na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba, 1. listopada. Iznos od 6 eura po godini staža mnogi smatraju sramotnim, a ukidanje poreza na mirovine _ pogodovanjem onima s najvišim primanjima. S druge strane, Vlada i koalicijski partner Hrvatska stranka umirovljenika ističu da se time doprinosi unaprjeđenju položaja starijih sugrađana. No, da većina jedva preživljava, svakodnevno svjedoče upravo umirovljenici. Nažalost, malen je broj onih čije mirovine prelaze prosjek i koji će osjetiti povećanje nakon primjene nove porezne politike. Više od 60 posto od ukupno milijun i dvjesto tisuća umirovljenika prima mirovine niže od prosjeka, koji službeno iznosi 690 eura. O svemu tome _ i o načinu na koji se došlo do iznosa od 6 eura po godini staža _ u emisiji Treća dob u ponedjeljak na govorit će predsjednica Sindikata umirovljenika Hrvatske Višnja Stanišić, a pojašnjenje će dati i državni tajnik Marinko Luikneda.

programme.title: Lidia's kitchen / Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: This sequel is Ricotte. Lidia will prepare simple with grandson Miles, and the delicious Bruscheta of a maximum of three ingredients. We will then see a version of a classic roast pasta dish, which everyone loves _ pancakes stuffed with spinach and ricott. The dessert will be cookies with ricott and chocolate pieces, a favorite in Lydia's family. Join Lydia and learn how versatile Ricotta is. / Ovaj je nastavak u znaku ricotte. Lidia će s unukom Milesom pripremiti jednostavne, a slasne bruskete od najviše tri sastojka. Potom ćemo vidjeti inačicu klasičnog jela od pečene tjestenine, koje svi vole _ palačinke nadjevene špinatom i ricottom. Desert će biti kolačići s ricottom i komadićima čokolade, omiljeni u Lidijinoj obitelji. Pridružite se Lidiji i naučite koliko je ricotta svestrana.

programme.title: Dr. Beck / Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Children are the most vulnerable participants in traffic. They travel to school every day, for training, play on the streets and sidewalks, and their safety is largely in our hands. How much do we teach them traffic rules, how many are adults responsible, what can we do to make their way safe? / Djeca su najranjiviji sudionici u prometu. Svakodnevno putuju u školu, na treninge, igraju se na ulicama i pločnicima, a njihova sigurnost u velikoj je mjeri u našim rukama. Koliko ih učimo prometnim pravilima, koliko smo mi odrasli odgovorni, što možemo učiniti da im put bude siguran?

programme.title: Diary 1 / Dnevnik 1
programme.desc: Current information and the latest news from the country and the world in the midday diary. / Aktualne informacije i najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta u podnevnom Dnevniku.

programme.title: Sport / Sport
programme.desc: Daily sports reports and reports. / Dnevni sportski izvještaji i reportaže.

programme.title: Time / Vrijeme
programme.desc: Dnevnik 1 is followed by a weather forecast, with meteozenity and warnings to dangerous weather, and on the eve of the diary 2 of the summary weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Marco tries to justify his threats to Tiago, claiming it is because of the love of Cacau. Rui thinks the Baron of a cheater who wanted to deceive Simone. Cacau decides to give up shared custody of the child, stating that Marco does not deserve to have contacts with their son. Valdemar persuades Susana to work for him. / Marco pokušava opravdati svoje prijetnje Tiagu tvrdeći da je to zbog ljubavi prema Cacau. Rui misli da je barun varalica koji je htio prevariti Simone. Cacau se odluči odreći zajedničkog skrbništva nad djetetom, navodeći da Marco ne zaslužuje imati kontakte s njihovim sinom. Valdemar nagovori Susanu da radi za njega.

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: Jana tells Píja that the blood on the rug could be Tomás. Cruz warned ángelo not pushing her nose into what she was not concerned. Manuel tells her father that he wants to leave La Provece. Santos threatens Píji _ He knows she killed Baron de Linai. / Jana kaže Píji da bi krv na sagu mogla biti Tomásova. Cruz upozori Ángelu da ne gura nos u ono što je se ne tiče. Manuel kaže ocu da želi otići s La Promesa. Santos zaprijeti Píji _ on zna da je ubila baruna De Linaju.

programme.title: Herbs / Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: The herb hunter visits the "Croatian Sahara", which is made up of the remains of the only Croatian desert and the geographical-Botanical reserve. The desert is located on the eastern part of the town of Đurđevac. Đurđevac Sands represent a variety of habitats for the entire living settlement. Some of the plants in this episode are gray thunder, silk, chin chin, early hamster, rabbit and medicinal asparagus. The guests of the episode are B.Sc. Geology Martin Mahović and Željka Kolar from the Public Institution for Management of Protected Nature Parts in the Koprivnica-Križevci County. / Lovac na bilje posjećuje "Hrvatsku Saharu" koju čine ostaci jedine hrvatske pustinje i geografsko-botanički rezervat. Pustinja se nalazi na istočnom dijelu Grada Đurđevca. Đurđevački pijesci predstavljaju raznolika staništa za cijelo živo naselje. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su siva gromotulja, svilenica, vlasulja bradica, rani hrčak, zečjak i ljekovita šparoga. Gosti epizode su dipl. ing. geologije Martin Mahović i Željka Kolar iz Javne ustanove za upravljanje zaštićenim dijelovima prirode na području Koprivničko-križevačke županije.

programme.title: Flowers Sasha Sekovje / Cvijeće Saše Šekoranje
programme.desc: Our famous artist and arranger Sasa Šekoranja shows us how we can make our own floral magic at home. / Naš poznati umjetnik i aranžer Saša Šekoranja pokazuje nam kako kod kuće možemo napraviti vlastitu cvjetnu čaroliju.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - the people of the wilderness / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: The Ben Fogle adventurer will spend the week in the Portuguese Highlands with Alex, 39, a British who once dealt with the sale of outdoor stay equipment and today live on the slope of the mountain. The psychic crisis and personal tragedy forced him to reconsider his life and move out of Britain. Ben will find out that Alex once survived without heating, electricity and water. Today, it remodges centuries -old buildings into an ideal farmhouse. She will tell Ben what challenges face by living in the hottest part of Portugal, and that, although he enjoys a solitary life, he is ready to hang out with like -minded people again. Among the like -minded people is a friend who helps him accomplish the plan to open the farm for guests. And she has an exceptional life story. / Pustolov Ben Fogle provest će tjedan u portugalskom gorju s Alexom (39), Britancem koji se nekoć bavio prodajom opreme za boravak na otvorenom, a danas samotno živi na obronku planine. Psihička kriza i osobna tragedija prisilile su ga da preispita život i odseli se iz Britanije. Ben će saznati kako je Alex svojedobno preživio bez grijanja, struje i vode. Danas preuređuje stoljetne građevine u idealan seoski dom. Ispričat će Benu s kakvim se izazovima suočava živeći u najtoplijem dijelu Portugala i kako je, premda uživa u samotnjačkom životu, spreman ponovno se družiti s istomišljenicima. Među istomišljenicima je i prijateljica koja mu pomaže ostvariti plan da farmu otvori za goste. I ona ima iznimnu životnu priču.

programme.title: Maze / Labirint
programme.desc: In the heart of the post -war Yugoslavia, Industrogradnja, a company that changed cities and lives, was born. Skyscrapers, hotels, monumental bridges, housing _ _ It all built it. And it was built in Germany, Poland, Iraq, Russia ... Moscow adorns the impressive Russian Academy of Sciences, which is their hands. In the show "Legend of Industrogradnja" we discover stories behind concrete and steel, we explore who created and who destroyed Industrogradnja. How did the construction giant who once counted 12,500 employees disappear? / U srcu poslijeratne Jugoslavije rodila se Industrogradnja, firma koja je mijenjala gradove i živote. Neboderi, hoteli, monumentalni mostovi, stambeni objekti _ sve je to ona gradila. A gradilo se u Njemačkoj, Poljskoj, Iraku, Rusiji... Moskvu krasi impresivna Ruska akademija znanosti koja je njihovih ruku djelo. U emisiji "Legenda o Industrogradnji" otkrivamo priče iza betona i čelika, istražujemo tko je stvarao, a tko rušio Industrogradnju. Kako je nestao građevinski div koji je nekad brojao 12.500 zaposlenih?

programme.title: Parenting in the animal world / Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: On the open lawns of our planet, parents must constantly weigh between risk and gain when raising the next generation. Although abundant grass promises an abundance of food and places where the family can settle, open regions mean competition and predators. In England, the imaginative potter is exploiting all the grace of the lawn. Skillfully builds a clay cradle and is full to the top of the offspring for offspring they will never meet. In the Keni Park, Masai Mara Geprodica on the outdoor expanses of the cubs shows the hunting skills they will need when they grow up. It will be crucial when she needs help with the gnu cub. It is more difficult for others to achieve. On the open plains of Donji Zambezi, everything is on the side of the thirty -member pack of wild dogs. But parents have to instill a sense of discipline into their inexperienced cubs or hunting can perish. In India, Mother Langu's must learn to be good nanny before they take on the role of parents _ and to some it does not fall easy! It is a world where the balance between risk and gain is constantly changing: parents everywhere in Ravnice are forced to new and difficult decisions. In the Kalahari nests of brownish sparrows, the largest in the world, usually protecting the colony from the sun's heat. But unbearable thermal wave causes the breakdown of social order as dissatisfied neighbors begin to throw birds out of the nest. In Patagonia, the mother of Gvanak must join thousands of others in an attempt to arrive at winter feding sites for the survival of their descendants, in which they are disturbed by kilometers and kilometers of fences. Adversity and parents are increasingly difficult for animal parents, but people can provide simple solutions. / Na otvorenim travnjacima našeg planeta roditelji moraju pri podizanju sljedećeg naraštaja stalno vagati između rizika i dobitka. Iako obilna trava obećava obilje hrane i mjesta na kojima se obitelj može nastaniti, otvoreni predjeli znače konkurenciju i grabežljivce. U Engleskoj domišljata lončarska osa iskorištava svu blagodat travnjaka. Vješto gradi glinenu kolijevku i puni je do vrha gusjenicama za potomstvo koje nikad neće upoznati. U kenijskom parku Masai Mara gepardica na otvorenom prostranstvu mladuncima pokazuje lovačke vještine koje će im trebati kad odrastu. Bit će to presudno kad joj zatreba pomoć u obaranju mladunca gnua. Drugima je ravnotežu teže postići. Na otvorenim ravnicama donjeg Zambezija, sve je na strani trideseteročlanog čopora divljih pasa. Ali roditelji moraju u svoje neiskusne mladunce usaditi osjećaj discipline ili im lov može propasti. U Indiji majke langura moraju naučiti biti dobre dadilje prije nego što preuzmu ulogu roditelja _ a nekima to ne pada lako! To je svijet u kojem se ravnoteža između rizika i dobitka stalno mijenja: roditelji svugdje u ravnicama prisiljeni su na nove i teške odluke. U Kalahariju gnijezda smeđokapih vrabaca, najveća na svijetu, obično štite koloniju od sunčeve topline. No nepodnošljivi toplinski val uzrokuje raspad društvenog poretka jer nezadovoljni susjedi počinju izbacivati ptiće iz gnijezda. U Patagoniji majka gvanaka mora se pridružiti tisućama drugih u pokušaju da stigne na zimska hranilišta radi opstanka njihovih potomaka, u čemu ih ometaju kilometri i kilometri ograde. Nedaće i roditelje životinjskim je roditeljima sve teže zaobići, ali ljudi mogu pružiti jednostavna rješenja.

programme.desc: The sugar reed mill is flooded. The village was destroyed and many residents lost almost everything and became homeless. They have to sleep in old slave dwellings in the mill. Isadora spends the night in housing for slaves with all workers who help around everything and around Rafael. programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The long -awaited amount of annual pension supplement, colloquially called the thirteenth pension, was welcomed as a cold shower for many pensioners _ Just on the International Day of the Elderly, October 1. The amount of 6 euros per year is considered as shameful, and the abolition of pension taxes _ by favoring those with the highest income. On the other hand, the Government and coalition partner of the Croatian pensioner party point out that this contributes to the improvement of the position of the elderly fellow citizens. But most of them barely survive, pensioners are testified daily. Unfortunately, there are a small number of those whose pensions exceed the average and who will feel an increase after applying a new tax policy. More than 60 percent of a total of one million and two hundred thousand retirees receive pensions lower than the average, which officially amounts to 690 euros. It will be the president of the Croatian Pensioners' Union on Monday about all this and the way of 6 euros per year of the year _ in the show on Monday on Monday, and State Secretary of State Marinko Luikned will be given. / Dugoočekivani iznos godišnjeg dodatka na mirovinu, kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina, dočekan je kao hladan tuš za mnoge umirovljenike _ upravo na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba, 1. listopada. Iznos od 6 eura po godini staža mnogi smatraju sramotnim, a ukidanje poreza na mirovine _ pogodovanjem onima s najvišim primanjima. S druge strane, Vlada i koalicijski partner Hrvatska stranka umirovljenika ističu da se time doprinosi unaprjeđenju položaja starijih sugrađana. No, da većina jedva preživljava, svakodnevno svjedoče upravo umirovljenici. Nažalost, malen je broj onih čije mirovine prelaze prosjek i koji će osjetiti povećanje nakon primjene nove porezne politike. Više od 60 posto od ukupno milijun i dvjesto tisuća umirovljenika prima mirovine niže od prosjeka, koji službeno iznosi 690 eura. O svemu tome _ i o načinu na koji se došlo do iznosa od 6 eura po godini staža _ u emisiji Treća dob u ponedjeljak na govorit će predsjednica Sindikata umirovljenika Hrvatske Višnja Stanišić, a pojašnjenje će dati i državni tajnik Marinko Luikneda.

Svakodnevno putuju u školu, na treninge, igraju se na ulicama i pločnicima, a njihova sigurnost u velikoj je mjeri u našim rukama. programme.title: Duel of the earth / Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: On Dugi Island, the Žamer family shows how it is possible to make a living from agriculture and in island conditions. In addition to the production of cheese, vegetables and eggs, the family runs Robinson tourism on the islet of Krkknat. The episode also brings the story of Goran Morovic, the owner of a luxury hotel on Dugi Otok, who brings in a new dimension of tourism into an island life. / Na Dugom otoku obitelj Žampera pokazuje kako je moguće živjeti od poljoprivrede i u otočnim uvjetima. Njihove koze, kokoši i svinje su izvor hrane i ponosa, jer biti pastir na otoku znači čuvati tradiciju i identitet. Osim proizvodnje sira, povrća i jaja, obitelj vodi robinzonski turizam na otočiću Krknata. programme.title: Remember to leave the review / Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
