The concert was prepared with the mentorship of prof. Veljko Valentina Skorvage and Maestro Sinisa Leopold. The virtuoso solo skills were evoked by performing works by world and domestic authors in various stylish expressions. The players of the HRT Tamburitza orchestra and the Zagreb Music Academy, united in a unique tamburitza corpus, also accompanied the award-winning vocal soloists Tena Lončarević and Matej Predojević Petrić, who tried to arise by the greats of Jakov Gotovac, and the young clarinetist Ana-Maria Klasan performed Virtuoso variations Emila Cossetta. In addition to the excellent soloists on the tamburitza _ Marin Juric, Fran Brlekovic and Nikola Vilus _ Osebujan arranger donation was brought to us by Roberto Hren and Fran Brlekovic. / Tamburaški orkestar HRT-a u svome koncertnom ciklusu, od 2015., predstavlja i mlade talentirane glazbenike. U goste su došli sjajni mladi umjetnici _ studenti petogodišnjeg instrumentalnog studija tambure na Muzičkoj akademiji u Zagrebu, Odsjek tambura. Koncert su pripremili uz mentorstvo prof. Veljka Valentina Škorvage i maestra Siniše Leopolda. Virtuozno solističko umijeće dočarali su izvodeći djela svjetskih i domaćih autora u različitim stilskim izričajima. Svirači Tamburaškog orkestra HRT-a i Muzičke akademije u Zagrebu, sjedinjeni u jedinstveni tamburaški korpus, popratili su i nagrađivane vokalne soliste Tenu Lončarević i Mateja Predojevića Petrića, koji su se okušali u arijama velikana Jakova Gotovca, a mlada klarinetistica Ana-Maria Klasan izvela je virtuozne Čardaš varijacije iz Međimurja Emila Cossetta. Uz vrsne soliste na tamburi _ Marina Jurića, Frana Brlekovića i Nikolu Vilusa _ osebujnu aranžersku darovitost donijeli su nam Roberto Hren i Fran Brleković.

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: In this story of the growth islands, which are also the youngest and oldest islands on the Adriatic, we will introduce unique geological and geomorphological phenomena of the surplus archipelago. At the same time, we will go through the highest concentration of nature monuments and the protected landscapes of this _ last paradise oasis of the Mediterranean, as the Vis Archipelago proclaimed the World Nature Protection Organization. We will start a journey with the famous travel writer, scientist and geologist Albert Fortis, who sailed 250 years ago and concluded that he was in the middle of a volcanic triangle. But although an apple islet like a black piramid from a volcanic diabetes rose over the sea, Fortis was still fooled. With the professional help of our guide, we will find out that these volcanic rocks of apples, Brussels and Palagruza found themselves there. We will get acquainted with the main feature of the surplus archipelago _ with salt diapins. Find out what an ordinary kitchen salt can do, 220 million years ago, together with magmatic and volcanic rocks deep in the Earth's bark. We will walk around the landscaped geostasis, sail like Tin Ujevic around the island of Saints, visit Brusnik and collect new insights at the Komiš Pirates and Kemenice beaches overlooking the granddiozing natural amphitheater of the Bay of Komiš. We will look for traces of dinosaurs who were pushed by these tidal plains 100 million years ago. In addition to geology, we will be accompanied by a rich cultural heritage of this distant islands. So we will find out how the sand dunes from the younger Stone Age are connected with the best Croatian wine, Mali. Join us on a boat trip, on foot, through the caves of blue and green, on gravel bays and the highest peaks. Participants: Ph.D. Tvrtko Korbar, Scientific Advisor, Croatian Geological Institute; Filip Prelec, geologist in Geopark Vis Archipelago; Lana Schmidt, Executive Director of Geopark Viska Archipelago. / U ovoj priči o otocima koji rastu, koji su ujedno i najmlađi i najstariji otoci na Jadranu upoznat ćemo jedinstvene geološke i geomorfološke pojave Viškoga arhipelaga. Ujedno ćemo proći kroz najveću koncentraciju spomenika prirode i zaštićenih krajolika ove _ posljednje rajske oaze Mediterana, kako je Viški arhipelag proglasila Svjetska organizacija za zaštitu prirode. Započet ćemo putovanje sa znamenitim putopiscem, znanstvenikom i geologom Albertom Fortisom, koji je prije 250 godina plovio ovim krajem i zaključio da se nalazi usred vulkanskoga trokuta. No, premda se otočić Jabuka poput crne piramide od vulkanskoga dijabaza uzdiže nad morem, Fortis se ipak prevario. Uz stručnu pomoć našega vodiča doznat ćemo kako su se te vulkanske stijene Jabuke, Brusnika i Palagruže tu našle. Upoznat ćemo se s glavnim obilježjem Viškoga arhipelaga _ solnim dijapirima. Saznati što sve može napraviti obična kuhinjska sol pokopana prije 220 milijuna godina zajedno s magmatskim i vulkanskim stijenama duboko u Zemljinoj kori. Prošetat ćemo se uređenim geostazama, ploviti poput Tina Ujevića oko otoka Sveca, posjetiti Brusnik i skupljati nove spoznaje na komiškim plažama Gusarica i Kemenice s pogledom na grandiozni prirodni amfiteatar Komiškoga zaljeva. Potražit ćemo tragove dinosaura koji su gacali ovim plimnim ravnicama prije 100 milijuna godina. Uz geologiju, pratit će nas i bogato kulturno nasljeđe ovoga udaljenoga otočja. Tako ćemo doznati kako su povezane pješčane dine iz mlađeg kamenog doba s ponajboljim hrvatskim vinom Plavcem malim. Pridružite nam se na putovanju brodom, pješice, kroz špilje modre i zelene, na šljunčane uvale i najviše vrhove. Sudjeluju: dr. sc. Tvrtko Korbar, znanstveni savjetnik, Hrvatski geološki institut; Filip Prelec, geolog u Geoparku Viški arhipelag; Lana Schmidt, izvršna direktorica Geoparka Viški arhipelag.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Ceremony / Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuh every morning, every day from 6.30am to 1pm. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: A collector of sounds / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories of sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active being called "sound collector", which has a passion for sound and all the concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he hears very poorly. This small being spends his days discovering and learning new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are the most common sounds of the sea, sounds that produce beings in the sea, the sounds produced by insects, including snoring his best friend and pet Marta. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The garbage collector of the mayor of Humdinger died the beach. Rocky goes to rescue with a new recycling truck. // Princess's gift is scattered all over the city. Rocky kreće u spašavanje s novim kamionom za reciklažu. // Princezin poklon rasut je po cijelom gradu. Sve ovisi o Rockyju i kamionu za recikliranje, kako bi opet sastavio poklon.

programme.title: It's time for Timmy / Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just been three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the herd, he used to being all over his. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. In each episode, one day is shown in kindergarten. The daily routine of the only crazy toddler disrupts. Through various events and accidents, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.desc: Krceki is a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanuts. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they fall into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem, they always invent a machine. The machine does not always work the way they imagined and emerge many humorous and unforeseen situations. / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije.

programme.desc: In addition to the animated series of Krceki, we are also coming to us by seven rhymes: bragger, plack, smart, good, angry, shy and brave. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

In this episode, Marko gets the task of helping educators prepare a bird feeding workshop, and she will learn that one of the most important tasks of zoos is precisely education and learning about animals, both children and adults. / U serijalu VOLIM ŽIVOTINJE ZOO upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može obaviti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu. U ovoj epizodi Marko dobiva zadatak pomoći edukatorima pripremiti radionicu izrade hranilica za ptice, uz to naučit će da je jedna od najvažnijih zadaća zooloških vrtova upravo obrazovanje i učenje o životinjama, i djece i odraslih.

Spend the morning in the company of a two -year -old! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. programme.title: Mali Malabar / Mali Malabar
programme.desc: In the water the whale is much faster than the little Malebar, and it is slower on the mainland. The Ocean will explain that it was not always the case because in ancient times and whale could run quickly. Little Malabar will go to race with whale ancestors ... In ancient times, four -legged land animals began to swim. After many generations, they evolved into sea mammals like whales, which still exist today. / U vodi je kit puno brži od malog Malabara, a na kopnu je sporiji. Ocean će objasniti da to nije uvijek bilo tako jer je u davno doba i kit mogao brzo trčati. Mali Malabar otići će se utrkivati s kitovim precima... U davno su doba četveronožne kopnene životinje počele plivati. Nakon mnogo naraštaja evoluirale su u morske sisavce poput kitova, koji i danas postoje.

programme.desc: "Peppa Praščić" is a British animated TV series for preschool children. This long -standing series for children is accompanied by the events and accidents of Peppe and her friends, her brother George, their parents and other animal families living in their city. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. In age, when small bunnies (like small children) are studying in people and experience challenges in relation to their parents, they move to school, learn generally about the world, they face authorities and, of course, learn their language. Children can take Simon for an example of taking care of himself, I can learn from him and from his incompetents, from situations where simon needs to give in in his insistence and spoiling, and always remain polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on books Stephanie Blake in the edition of the French publisher Lecole des loisirs. He was directed by the TV series Julien Cayot, and it was produced by Go-N Productions. The series in France had Prime Minister 17. December 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.desc: Bitz baked a super creamy strawberry cake, which is so tasty that Bob suggested that she start selling it around the world. / Bitz je ispekla super kremastu tortu od jagoda, koja je toliko ukusna da joj je Bob predložio da je počne prodavati diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Dinoranch / Dinoranč

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: In this story of the growth islands, which are also the youngest and oldest islands on the Adriatic, we will introduce unique geological and geomorphological phenomena of the surplus archipelago. At the same time, we will go through the highest concentration of nature monuments and the protected landscapes of this _ last paradise oasis of the Mediterranean, as the Vis Archipelago proclaimed the World Nature Protection Organization. We will start a journey with the famous travel writer, scientist and geologist Albert Fortis, who sailed 250 years ago and concluded that he was in the middle of a volcanic triangle. But although an apple islet like a black piramid from a volcanic diabetes rose over the sea, Fortis was still fooled. With the professional help of our guide, we will find out that these volcanic rocks of apples, Brussels and Palagruza found themselves there. We will get acquainted with the main feature of the surplus archipelago _ with salt diapins. Find out what an ordinary kitchen salt can do, 220 million years ago, together with magmatic and volcanic rocks deep in the Earth's bark. We will walk around the landscaped geostasis, sail like Tin Ujevic around the island of Saints, visit Brusnik and collect new insights at the Komiš Pirates and Kemenice beaches overlooking the granddiozing natural amphitheater of the Bay of Komiš. We will look for traces of dinosaurs who were pushed by these tidal plains 100 million years ago. In addition to geology, we will be accompanied by a rich cultural heritage of this distant islands. So we will find out how the sand dunes from the younger Stone Age are connected with the best Croatian wine, Mali. Join us on a boat trip, on foot, through the caves of blue and green, on gravel bays and the highest peaks. Participants: Ph.D. Tvrtko Korbar, Scientific Advisor, Croatian Geological Institute; Filip Prelec, geologist in Geopark Vis Archipelago; Lana Schmidt, Executive Director of Geopark Viska Archipelago. / U ovoj priči o otocima koji rastu, koji su ujedno i najmlađi i najstariji otoci na Jadranu upoznat ćemo jedinstvene geološke i geomorfološke pojave Viškoga arhipelaga. Ujedno ćemo proći kroz najveću koncentraciju spomenika prirode i zaštićenih krajolika ove _ posljednje rajske oaze Mediterana, kako je Viški arhipelag proglasila Svjetska organizacija za zaštitu prirode. Započet ćemo putovanje sa znamenitim putopiscem, znanstvenikom i geologom Albertom Fortisom, koji je prije 250 godina plovio ovim krajem i zaključio da se nalazi usred vulkanskoga trokuta. No, premda se otočić Jabuka poput crne piramide od vulkanskoga dijabaza uzdiže nad morem, Fortis se ipak prevario. Uz stručnu pomoć našega vodiča doznat ćemo kako su se te vulkanske stijene Jabuke, Brusnika i Palagruže tu našle. Upoznat ćemo se s glavnim obilježjem Viškoga arhipelaga _ solnim dijapirima. Saznati što sve može napraviti obična kuhinjska sol pokopana prije 220 milijuna godina zajedno s magmatskim i vulkanskim stijenama duboko u Zemljinoj kori. Prošetat ćemo se uređenim geostazama, ploviti poput Tina Ujevića oko otoka Sveca, posjetiti Brusnik i skupljati nove spoznaje na komiškim plažama Gusarica i Kemenice s pogledom na grandiozni prirodni amfiteatar Komiškoga zaljeva. Potražit ćemo tragove dinosaura koji su gacali ovim plimnim ravnicama prije 100 milijuna godina. Uz geologiju, pratit će nas i bogato kulturno nasljeđe ovoga udaljenoga otočja. Tako ćemo doznati kako su povezane pješčane dine iz mlađeg kamenog doba s ponajboljim hrvatskim vinom Plavcem malim. Pridružite nam se na putovanju brodom, pješice, kroz špilje modre i zelene, na šljunčane uvale i najviše vrhove. Sudjeluju: dr. sc. Tvrtko Korbar, znanstveni savjetnik, Hrvatski geološki institut; Filip Prelec, geolog u Geoparku Viški arhipelag; Lana Schmidt, izvršna direktorica Geoparka Viški arhipelag.

programme.title: Meet John Doe / Upoznajte Johna Doea
programme.desc: After the newspaper in which he works Buy right oriented Tikun D.B. Norton (E. Arnold), which changes the list changes to the New Bulletin, Journalist Ann Mitchell (B. Stanwyck) soon he finds himself among those whom Henry Connell editor (J. Gleason) decides to share cancellations. To avoid the loss of work, Ann in its last column publish a fictitious letter of non-existent John Doa, allegedly dissatisfied and bitter citizen who threatens that the Holy Hall in the world will jump off the city hall building. After the letter intrigues local politicians and attract huge public attention, which is why the newspaper starts unnegistrivably grow, Editor Ann offers great money in exchange for a series of texts about John Doe. And when she admits to him that it was a fictional character, Connell consent helps her finding a man who will present the public as John Doe. Their selection soon falls on the former baseball player, and now the homeless and rogue Long John Willoughby (Mr. Cooper). / Nakon što novine u kojima radi kupi desno orijentirani tajkun D.B. Norton (E. Arnold), koji naziv lista promijeni u The New Bulletin, novinarka Ann Mitchell (B. Stanwyck) ubrzo se nađe među onima kojima glavni urednik Henry Connell (J. Gleason) odluči podijeliti otkaze. Da bi izbjegla gubitak posla, Ann u svojoj posljednjoj kolumni objavi izmišljeno pismo nepostojećeg Johna Doa, navodnog nezadovoljnog i ogorčenog građanina koji prijeti da će na Badnjak točno u ponoć u znak protesta protiv truleži u svijetu skočiti sa zgrade gradske vijećnice. Nakon što pismo zaintrigira lokalne političare i privuče golemu pozornost javnosti, zbog čega naklada novina počne nezadrživo rasti, urednik Ann ponudi veliki novac u zamjenu za seriju tekstova o Johnu Doeu. A kad mu ona prizna da je to izmišljeni lik, Connell joj pristane pomoći u pronalaženju čovjeka kojeg će javnosti predstaviti kao Johna Doea. Njihov izbor ubrzo padne na nekadašnjeg igrača bejzbola, a sad beskućnika i skitnicu Long Johna Willoughbyja (G. Cooper).

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: In today's show, we are talking about the novel "Max, Mischa and the offensive of the aunt" by Johan Hartad, who has been proclaimed a book for a decade in Norway. We discover that this extensive work that questions the world of theater, identity, wars and trauma will premiere on the stage of the ZKM on October 17th. He will reveal his vision of this work full of references to the film, theater and music, which is at the center of the life of directors and artists, director Ivica Buljan and music author Darko Rundek in the studio. On the show, we will see a clip from rehearsal and talking to the actors and a conversation recorded in Oslo 2023 with the author of Romana visited by Ivona Haller in his home. / U današnjoj emisiji govorimo o romanu "Max, Mischa i ofenziva Tet" autora Johana Harstada, koji je u Norveškoj proglašen knjigom desetljeća. Otkrivamo kako će to opsežno djelo koje propituje svijet kazališta, identiteta, ratova i trauma 17. listopada premijerno zaživjeti na pozornici ZKM-a. Svoju viziju tog djela prepunog referencija na film, kazalište i glazbu, kojemu je u središtu život redatelja i umjetnika, otkrit će nam u studiju redatelj Ivica Buljan te autor glazbe Darko Rundek. U emisiji ćemo vidjeti isječak s probe i razgovor s glumcima te razgovor snimljen u Oslu 2023. s autorom romana kojeg je u njegovu domu posjetila Ivona Haller.

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: We present a great book of lyric poetry _ anthology, which was organized in three Thomas by poet Slobodan Blagojevic. It is the first edition that covers the poetic traditions of Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and Croatia in a time range of one millennium. Literary is also fascinating and the new novel by Montenegrin author Milorad Popovic, a court square, named after the central square in Cetinje, the old capital of Montenegro. Fourth novel by Olja Knezevic, Strada Fortunat, is the winner of the T-Portal Award for Best Novel and is dramatized for the third program of Croatian Radio. The author reaches for her own life experience, but although the storyteller, the protagonist and the author are partially overlapping, it is not a classic automation. Like Olja Knezevic and the Italian author Veronica Raimo, she plays with autobiography _ already in the title of the novel I claim to be lying when Zinem. Her fourth novel was the finalist of the prestigious Straga Award and the winner in the two categories: Strga off, awarded by bookstores, and Straga Giovani, selected by young readers. / Predstavljamo Veliku knjigu lirske poezije _ antologiju koju je u tri toma priredio pjesnik Slobodan Blagojević. Riječ je o prvom izdanju koje obuhvaća pjesničke tradicije Srbije, Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore i Hrvatske u vremenskom rasponu od jednog tisućljeća. Književno je fascinantan i novi roman crnogorskog autora Milorada Popovića, Dvorski trg, nazvan prema središnjem trgu na Cetinju, staroj prijestolnici Crne Gore. Četvrti roman Olje Knežević, Strada fortunata, dobitnik je nagrade T-portala za najbolji roman te je dramatiziran za Treći program Hrvatskoga radija. Autorica u njemu poseže u vlastito životno iskustvo, no iako se pripovjedačica, protagonistica i autorica djelomično preklapaju, riječ nije o klasičnoj autofikciji. Poput Olje Knežević i talijanska autorica Veronica Raimo poigrava se autobiografijom _ već u naslovu romana tvrdi Lažem kad zinem. Njezin četvrti roman bio je finalist prestižne nagrade Strega te pobjednik u dvjema kategorijama: Strega Off, koju dodjeljuju knjižari, i Strega Giovani, koju biraju mladi čitatelji.

programme.title: From the animator / Animatik
programme.desc: A show dedicated to artistic short animated films of Croatian and foreign authors. Through contributions and conversations with guests in the studio, Animatics thematizes individual aspects of work on an animated film by showing both new and classic works of Croatian and world animation. / Emisija posvećena umjetničkim kratkometražnim animiranim filmovima hrvatskih i inozemnih autora. Kroz priloge i razgovore s gostima u studiju Animatik tematizira pojedine aspekte rada na animiranom filmu prikazujući i nova i klasična djela hrvatske i svjetske animacije.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: The Stockholm archipelago covers more than 30,000 islands and islets. This world begins just a few kilometers from the center of Stockholm, extends far into the Baltic Sea and has retained a large part of its original charm. Because most of the island can only be reached by sea. This islands for many Swedes are an ideal place to spend the summer in their own country. But the Stockholm archipelago did not go for summer visitors and tourists. On the islet of Grinda is a rural estate of Maria Jorgenson. It is not easy to deal with agriculture in this islands at all. The cows driving a boat here are the usual scene. Sanham's Thimig Johansen lives on Sandhamn. The first day of summer is still celebrated here in the traditional way. Maritimeness left a mark everywhere on the islands and between them. Per Nakkk Roni for wreckage and a trace for well -preserved ships from the Hanzeth era. As in what museum on the seabed, their remains rest: anchors, cannonballs, clay cubes and ship boards. / Štokholmski arhipelag obuhvaća više od 30.000 otoka i otočića. Taj svijet počinje samo nekoliko kilometara od središta Stockholma, proteže se daleko u Baltičko more i zadržao je velik dio svojeg izvornog šarma. Jer na većinu otoka može se doći samo morskim putem. Ovo je otočje za mnoge Šveđane idealno mjesto za provođenje ljeta u vlastitoj zemlji. No Štokholmski arhipelag nije idila samo za ljetne posjetitelje i turiste. Na otočiću Grinda seosko je imanje Marije Jorgensson. Baviti se poljodjelstvom na ovom otočju uopće nije lako. Krave koje se voze brodom ovdje su uobičajen prizor. Na Sandhamnu živi Sanna Thimmig Johansen. Prvi dan ljeta ovdje se još slavi na tradicionalan način. Pomorstvo je ostavilo traga posvuda na otocima i između njih. Per Normark roni za olupinama i traga za dobro očuvanim brodovima iz hanzeatskog doba. Kao u kakvu muzeju na morskom dnu počivaju njihovi ostaci: sidra, topovske kugle, glineni ćupovi i brodske daske.

programme.title: Photos in Croatia / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors and topics in the history of Croatian photography and contemporary authors operating on the Croatian scene. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore i teme iz povijesti hrvatske fotografije te suvremene autore koji djeluju na hrvatskoj sceni.

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: In a time that does not suit cultural programs, marking a quarter of a century of Liburnia Jazz Festival in Opatija is an event that awakens optimism. The festival celebrated its 25 years from July 4 to July 6, and preceded the presentation of the monograph "Liburnia Jazz: 25 years", which remains a permanent document on the importance of the festival. The Liburnia Jazz Festival was the first big step into the world of jazz for many local musicians, giving them the opportunity not only to perform, but also to share a stage with big world names like Joe Zawilanu, Hiromi, Mike Stern, Richard Bone, Marie Joao, Medeski, Martin and Wood, and last year. This special year, the festival also emphasized its role as a meeting place _ gathering local and foreign musicians, different cultures and music traditions, which has always been an important component of his identity, along with music and various audiences. / U vremenu koje ne pogoduje trajanju kulturnih programa, obilježavanje četvrt stoljeća Liburnia Jazz Festivala u Opatiji događaj je koji budi optimizam. Festival je svojih 25 godina proslavio od 4. do 6. srpnja, a prethodilo mu je i predstavljanje monografije "Liburnia Jazz: 25 godina", koja ostaje trajni dokument o značaju festivala. Liburnia Jazz Festival bio je prva velika stepenica u svijet jazza za mnoge lokalne muzičare, pružajući im priliku ne samo da nastupe, nego i da dijele pozornicu s velikim svjetskim imenima poput Joea Zawinula, Hiromi, Mikea Sterna, Richarda Bone, Marie Joao, Medeskija, Martina And Wooda, a prošle godine i Richarda Galliana. Ove posebne godine festival je naglasio i svoju ulogu mjesta susreta _ okupljajući lokalne i inozemne glazbenike, različite kulture i muzičke tradicije, što je uvijek bila važna komponenta njegovog identiteta, zajedno s glazbom i različitim publikama.

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: Art _ Your Culture Address! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 8.10pm, we bring you the best from the art world and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Sundays at two / Nedjeljom u dva
programme.desc: The guest of the show on Sundays at 2 is Dusko Ilijevic, "Stricek Dusko", a educator at a kindergarten in Zagreb. Based on the 20-year experience of working with children, they will explain why he thinks today's parents are too indulgent and how to set the borders in their daily lives for children. Empathy, climbing the trees, jumping on the mud and using a cell phone are some of the topics of the show that talks about raising children. / Gost emisije Nedjeljom u 2 je Duško Ilijević, "striček Duško", odgajatelj u jednom zagrebačkom dječjem vrtiću. Na temelju 20-godišnjeg iskustva rada s djecom objasnit će zašto misli da su današnji roditelji previše popustljivi i kako djeci postaviti granice u svakodnevnom životu. Empatija, penjanje po drveću, skakanje po blatu i upotreba mobitela neke su od tema emisije u kojoj se govori o odgoju djece.

programme.title: Andrija Matijaš Pauk / Andrija Matijaš Pauk
programme.desc: Andrija Matijaš Pauk is a hero and the legend of the Homeland War. This is especially true of the southern front line from Dubrovnik and Zadar, to great tanks in storms and final operations. The tragic death of the penultimate day of the war in the approaches Mrkonjic made the legend even greater. "His" 4th HV Guards Brigade has been named _ spiders since then. Dark Darko Dovranic's documentary shows the life of Andrew Matijaš. It is logical that most of the film is dedicated to the war time, because in the most difficult moments and recognize the biggest heroes. The spider is testified by his fellow soldiers, but also Mother Anka and wife Nada, who decided to donate to the state's legacy to the state to guard. With the abundance of archival shots, this documentary testifies to the greatness and victim of man. / Andrija Matijaš Pauk junak je i legenda Domovinskog rata. Posebno se to odnosi na južnu bojišnicu od Dubrovnika i Zadra, do sjajnog vođenja tenkova u Oluji i završnim operacijama. Tragična pogibija predzadnjeg dana rata na prilazima Mrkonjić Gradu legendu je učinila još i većom. "Njegova" 4. gardijska brigada HV otada si je dodala naziv _ Pauci. Dokumentarni film Darka Dovranića prikazuje život Andrije Matijaša. Logično je da je najveći dio filma posvećen ratnom vremenu, jer se u najtežim trenutcima i prepoznaju najveći junaci. O Pauku svjedoče njegovi suborci, ali i majka Anka i supruga Nada koja je Paukovu ostavštinu odlučila pokloniti državi na čuvanje. Uz obilje arhivskih snimaka ovaj dokumentarac svjedoči o veličini i žrtvi Čovjeka.

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: We continue to explore Bregovit Croatia and travel to Moslavina and introduce you to the winemakers there and the pride of their region: scratch. At this year's Headoneast Festival in Osijek, the best of Slavonia and Baranja could taste. Meet the man who grows in Zagorje with hot peppers from all over the world, from which they produce sauces under the name I love angry. We take you to the exclusive premiere tasting of Meneghetti wines on their estate in Istria. Take a look at what all the Herzegovina village in Medjugorje represents, a complex that houses a winery and a tasting with the best delicacies of Herzegovina. In which ways all ways can be influenced by reducing waste of food in households and restaurants were discussed at a Zero Waste conference. / Nastavljamo istraživati bregovitu Hrvatsku te putujemo u Moslavinu i upoznajemo vas s tamošnjim vinarima i ponosom njihova kraja: škrletom. Na ovogodišnjem festivalu HeadOnEast u Osijeku moglo se kušati najbolje od Slavonije i Baranje. Upoznajte čovjeka koji u Zagorju uzgaja ljute papričice iz cijeloga svijeta od kojih proizvodi umake pod imenom Volim ljuto. Vodimo vas na ekskluzivno premijerno kušanje Meneghetti vina na njihovo imanje u Istri. Pogledajte što sve predstavlja Hercegovačko selo u Međugorju, kompleks u kojemu se nalazi vinarija i kušaona s najboljim hercegovačkim delicijama. Na koje se sve načine može utjecati na smanjenje otpada od hrane u kućanstvima i restoranima razgovaralo se na konferenciji Zero waste.

programme.title: Studio 4: Diagnosis / Studio 4: Dijagnoza
programme.desc: Chronic obstructive lung disease is a serious diagnosis that many patients are reluctant to recognize, often hide. Why is there a stigma related to this disease and how important is it for family doctors to be familiar with treatment protocols? What can modern medicine offer today in the diagnosis and therapy of COPD? GOŠCA: doc.dr.sc.andrere Vukic-Dugac, KBC _ Zagreb / Kronična opstruktivna bolest pluća ozbiljna je dijagnoza koju mnogi pacijenti nerado priznaju, često i skrivaju. Zašto postoji stigma vezana uz ovu bolest i koliko je važno da već obiteljski liječnici budu upoznati s protokolima liječenja? Što suvremena medicina danas može ponuditi u dijagnostici i terapiji KOPB-a? Gošca: doc.dr.sc.Andrea Vukic-Dugac, KBC _ Zagreb

programme.desc: Work is underway to revitalize the arboretum of brick in the municipality of Vinica near Varaždin. The introductory conference was recently held on the occasion of this project. Jaskovo is a small settlement within the City of Ozalj in Karlovac County. It was first mentioned in historical records back in 1433. It is in this ancient region that the economy of the Kovac family is located, which has a high -planned Scottish cattle in open pastures in free cultivation. In addition to cattle, the family grows in an eco -friendly pumpkin, nuts and hazelnuts. We also bring foreign news. U povodu tog projekta nedavno je održana i uvodna konferencija. Jaškovo je maleno naselje u sastavu grada Ozlja u Karlovačkoj županiji. Prvi se put spominje u povijesnim zapisima još davne 1433. kad knez Bartol Frankopan daruje Jaškovljanima paše oko rijeke Dobre na korištenje. Upravo se u tom drevnom kraju smjestilo gospodarstvo obitelji Kovač koja na otvorenim pašnjacima u slobodnom uzgoju ima visokoplaninsko škotsko govedo. programme.title: View across the border - Croats in BiH / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: - At the last minute, Bosnia and Herzegovina managed to accept the reform program and thus save the loss of an additional 108 million euros provided for by the EU growth plan for the country. However, there are nowhere near the problems, especially those of the political nature who have been burdened by BiH for years. On the annual clause of the HDZ of Bosnia and Herzegovina, held last week in Neum, there was also talk about the continuation of activities on the European Road of BiH. _ Health Minister Irena Hrstic and EU Regional Development and EU Funds Natasa Mikus Zigman, visited Mostar last week. As part of the visit, they toured the University Clinical Hospital of Mostar. They also participated in the presentation of a cross -border cooperation project called "Lifegate", where they submitted a contract with a total value of EUR 9.5 million. _ Catholic school center in Tuzla marked 30 years of existence. The General High School started operating in November 1995, and in 2001 classes in elementary school began. Currently, these two KCC schools are attended by about 650 students, employing 82 employees. At the end of last year, among 17 schools in Tuzla Canton, this school took the first place in the quality of education. _ Many places in Bosanska Posavina, including the Slatina Slatina near Šamac have a similar story, the population was exiled in the war, and the church and a large number of houses were destroyed. With the occupation of the locals, a new church was built, houses are being renovated and locals return to their area. This is evidenced by the newly built building of the Croatian Cultural Center. _ And in Bosanski Brod, the 33th anniversary of that city was marked. After a great sacrifice and 400 lost lives and 1200 wounded veterans, a Bosnian ship fell into hostile hands that day. In memory of all the killed and missing veterans, as well as civilian victims of the war, wreaths and candles were laid in the city cemetery. The Association of Volunteers and Veterans 101. _ Parish of St. Elijah the Prophet Cemerno is located not far from the Ilias, near Sarajevo. Before the war, only the Croatian population lived there. During the war, the Serbs demolished the church and the Croatian population expelled from the area. What the situation was thirty years later was checked by our team. _ From the Livno region, Croats have been moving out since the 1960s. Optimism is restored by some new trends _ immigration abroad of born _ Livno Croats who are triggered or continued by family affairs in their parents' homeland. _ At the Croatian House of Duke Stjepan Kosaca in Mostar, the premiere of the documentary "Konjic: 365 days" was held, directed by Matija Ricova. The film is part of the project "The Digital Victims of Croats in BiH", which is realized by the Youth Association "Born" from Zagreb with the aim of preserving the memories of the victims, documenting the truth about war crimes and the suffering of Croats in BiH. / - Bosna i Hercegovina u posljednjem je trenutku uspjela prihvatiti program reformi i na taj način spasiti gubitak dodatnih 108 milijuna eura predviđenih Planom rasta EU-a za tu zemlju. No, time ni blizu nisu riješeni problemi, osobito oni političke prirode koji godinama opterećuju BiH. Na godišnjoj klauzuri HDZ-a Bosne i Hercegovine, održanoj prošloga tjedna u Neumu, govorilo se i o nastavku aktivnosti na europskom putu BiH. _ Ministrice zdravstva Irena Hrstić i regionalnog razvoja i fondova EU-a Nataša Mikuš Žigman, prošli su tjedan posjetile Mostar. U sklopu posjeta obišle su Sveučilišnu kliničku bolnicu Mostar. Sudjelovale su i na predstavljanju projekta prekogranične suradnje pod nazivom "LifeGate", gdje su predale ugovor ukupne vrijednosti 9,5 milijuna eura. _ Katolički školski centar u Tuzli obilježio je 30 godina postojanja. Opća gimnazija započela je s radom u studenom 1995., a 2001. počela je i nastava u osnovnoj školi. Trenutačno, te dvije škole KŠC-a pohađa oko 650 učenika, a u njima su zaposlena 82 djelatnika. Potkraj prošle godine, među 17 škola u tuzlanskom kantonu, ta je škola zauzela prvo mjesto po kvaliteti obrazovanja. _ Mnoga mjesta u Bosanskoj Posavini, pa tako i Srednja Slatina kod Šamca imaju sličnu priču, stanovništvo je u ratu prognano, a crkva i velik broj kuća uništeni su. Zauzimanjem mještana izgrađena je nova crkva, obnavljaju se kuće i mještani se vraćaju u svoj kraj. O tome svjedoči i novoizgrađena zgrada Hrvatskog kulturnog centra. _ A u Bosanskom Brodu obilježena je 33. godišnjica od pada toga grada. Nakon velike žrtve i 400 izgubljenih života te 1200 ranjenih branitelja, tog dana u neprijateljske je ruke pao Bosanski Brod. U spomen na sve poginule i nestale branitelje, kao i civilne žrtve rata, na Gradskom groblju položeni su vijenci i upaljene svijeće. Udruga dragovoljaca i veterana 101. bosanskobrodske brigade HVO-a u suradnji s Koordinacijom udruga iz Domovinskog rata Brodsko-posavske županije organizirala je prigodan komemorativni program u Bosanskom i Slavonskom Brodu. _ Župa Svetog Ilije Proroka Čemerno smještena je nedaleko od Ilijaša, pokraj Sarajeva. Prije rata ondje je živjelo samo hrvatsko stanovništvo. Tijekom rata, Srbi su srušili crkvu, a hrvatsko stanovništvo protjerali iz tog kraja. Kakva je situacija trideset godina poslije provjerila je naša ekipa. _ Iz livanjskog kraja Hrvati se iseljavali još od šezdesetih godina prošlog stoljeća. Optimizam vraćaju neki novi trendovi _ doseljavanje u inozemstvu rođenih _ livanjskih Hrvata koji u zavičaju svojih roditelja pokreću ili nastavljaju obiteljske poslove. _ U Hrvatskom domu hercega Stjepana Kosače u Mostaru održana je premijera dokumentarnog filma "Konjic: 365 dana", u režiji Matije Ricova. Film je dio projekta "Digitalni žrtvoslov Hrvata u BiH", koji realizira Udruga mladih "Nanovo rođeni" iz Zagreba s ciljem očuvanja sjećanja na stradale, dokumentiranja istine o ratnim zločinima te stradanju Hrvata u BiH.

programme.title: Studio 4: Diagnosis / Studio 4: Dijagnoza
programme.desc: Chronic obstructive lung disease is a serious diagnosis that many patients are reluctant to recognize, often hide. Why is there a stigma related to this disease and how important is it for family doctors to be familiar with treatment protocols? What can modern medicine offer today in the diagnosis and therapy of COPD? GOŠCA: doc.dr.sc.andrere Vukic-Dugac, KBC _ Zagreb / Kronična opstruktivna bolest pluća ozbiljna je dijagnoza koju mnogi pacijenti nerado priznaju, često i skrivaju. Zašto postoji stigma vezana uz ovu bolest i koliko je važno da već obiteljski liječnici budu upoznati s protokolima liječenja? Što suvremena medicina danas može ponuditi u dijagnostici i terapiji KOPB-a? Gošca: doc.dr.sc.Andrea Vukic-Dugac, KBC _ Zagreb

programme.title: Evening show / Вечерното шоу
programme.desc: The Evening Show will entertain with exciting and frank conversations, music performances and many more surprises. / "Вечерното шоу" ще забавлява с вълнуващи и откровени разговори, с музикални изпълнения и още много изненади.

programme.title: Sports news / Спортни новини
programme.desc: Sports news from Bulgaria and the world. / Спортни новини от България и света.

programme.title: Non -gauge stories / Истории за неразказване
programme.desc: Five comic stories are crossed by chance, focused on the emotions and internal experiences and perceptions of the main characters. Some of them constantly confuse reality with desire, others lie more than they say. The stories that "are not for storytelling" contain situations of public humiliation, unhappy secrets, social and moral prejudices, cheating, jealousy and gossip. Experiences that every person, if he looks at himself, can identify. Each of them is mocking, but full of sympathy for people and their inability to manage their own emotions. The film deals with everything that stands between what we are and what we believe in and want. / Пет комични истории се кръстосват по случайност, фокусирани върху емоциите и вътрешните преживявания и възприятия на главните герои. Някои от тях постоянно объркват реалността с желанието, други лъжат повече, отколкото говорят. Историите, които "не са за разказване", съдържат ситуации на публично унижение, неизповядани тайни, социални и морални предразсъдъци, изневери, ревност и сплетни. Преживявания, с които всеки човек, ако се вгледа в себе си, може да се отъждестви. Всяка от тях е язвително присмехулна, но изпълнена със съчувствие към хората и тяхната неспособност да управляват собствените си емоции. Филмът се занимава с всичко, което стои между това, което сме и онова, в което вярваме и желаем.

programme.title: Arena Sports / Арена спорт
programme.desc: The analytical information sports show "Arena Sport" will take viewers beyond pure news in the sport, expanding them not only with a picture, but also with the first comments and reactions to what is happening. / Аналитично-информационното спортно предаване "Арена Спорт" ще отведе зрителите отвъд чистите новини в спорта, като ги разшири и обогати не само с картина, но и с първите коментари и реакции на случващото се.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Dimitar Iliev / Зала на славата: Димитър Илиев
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: beIN Zap / beIN Zap
Crime scene / Tatort
programme.desc: 16-year-old Lilly-Marie (Dilara Aylin Ziem) and her boyfriend Pascal (Florian GeiSSelmann) run away from the "Sieben Schlafer" youth home at night. The next morning, Lilly's body is found dead in a nearby lake. 17-year-old Pascal is on the run. Leonie Winkler (Cornelia Groschel) and Peter Michael Schnabel (Martin Brambach) take up the investigation and initiate a search for Pascal. At first glance, the “Seven Sleeper” presents itself as a model home. Under the direction of Saskia Ruhe (Silvina Buchbauer), children and young people who have not had it easy in their lives live here. Lilly's death is very close to the teacher Jasmin Hoffmann (Aysha Joy Samuel). She reports that Pascal is considered difficult and aggressive. That's why he, like other children in the home, is treated by psychiatrist Lukas Bruckner (Hanno Koffler). The search for Pascal is in full swing when another crime occurs: the head of the youth welfare office, Torsten Hess (Peter Moltzen), is found murdered... / Die 16-jahrige Lilly-Marie (Dilara Aylin Ziem) und ihr Freund Pascal (Florian GeiSSelmann) hauen nachts aus dem Jugendheim "Siebenschlafer" ab. Am nachsten Morgen wird Lillys Leiche tot in einem See in der Nahe aufgefunden. Der 17-jahrige Pascal ist fluchtig. Leonie Winkler (Cornelia Groschel) und Peter Michael Schnabel (Martin Brambach) nehmen die Ermittlungen auf und veranlassen die Fahndung nach Pascal. Das "Siebenschlafer" prasentiert sich auf den ersten Blick als Vorzeige-Heim. Unter der Leitung von Saskia Ruhe (Silvina Buchbauer) leben hier Kinder und Jugendliche, die es in ihrem Leben bisher nicht leicht hatten. Der Erzieherin Jasmin Hoffmann (Aysha Joy Samuel) geht Lillys Tod sehr nah. Von Pascal berichtet sie, dass er als schwierig und aggressiv gilt. Deswegen wird er, wie auch andere Kinder des Heims, vom Psychiater Lukas Bruckner (Hanno Koffler) therapiert. Die Fahndung nach Pascal lauft auf Hochtouren, als ein weiteres Verbrechen passiert: Der zustandige Abteilungsleiter im Jugendamt, Torsten Hess (Peter Moltzen), wird ermordet aufgefunden ...

programme.title: Caren Miosga / Caren Miosga
programme.sub-title: Was kostet uns der Aufschwung, Herr Klingbeil?
programme.desc: With the debt brake relaxed and the 500 billion euro special assets, the black-red coalition wants to renovate infrastructure, generate growth and resolve the investment backlog in municipalities. As finance minister, Lars Klingbeil has to share responsibility for the record debts and at the same time stimulate the economy. He is therefore trying to strike a balance between investments and budgetary discipline. Is the money actually going to the right projects or is it in danger of being lost in bureaucracy and poor planning? What does the reform of citizen money bring? And how can the transformation in Germany be carried out without endangering social cohesion? / Mit gelockerter Schuldenbremse und dem 500-Milliarden-Euro-Sondervermogen will die schwarz-rote Koalition Infrastruktur sanieren, Wachstum erzeugen und den Investitionsstau in Kommunen auflosen. Lars Klingbeil muss als Finanzminister die Rekordschulden mitverantworten und gleichzeitig die Wirtschaft ankurbeln. Er versucht deshalb den Spagat zwischen Investitionen und Haushaltsdisziplin. Kommt das Geld tatsachlich bei den richtigen Projekten an oder droht es in Burokratie und Fehlplanung zu versickern? Was bringt die Reform beim Burgergeld? Und wie lasst sich die Transformation in Deutschland gestalten, ohne den gesellschaftlichen Zusammenhalt zu gefahrden?

programme.title: Until we're dead or free / Bis wir tot sind oder frei
programme.desc: Zurich in the early 1980s: The combative lawyer Barbara Hug wants to completely overhaul the Swiss justice system. During the youth unrest - keyword "Zuri is burning" - she represents rebellious left-wing autonomists like the punk girl Heike and uses the court as a stage to draw attention to the grievances of a backward criminal law. One day, the rebellious son of an industrial dynasty and professional criminal Walter Sturm, who has just escaped from prison, seeks her advice. The charismatic storm contradicts all the rules, lives unconditional egoism and repeatedly clashes with the system. Not only Heike falls for his mischievous charm, Barbara also feels drawn to her client. Sturm, of all people, becomes a symbol of freedom and the dignity of the individual in left-wing circles and the youth movement - and thus the idol of an entire generation. When the "escape king" ends up in prison again while fleeing to Istanbul, he is placed in solitary confinement. But this time the situation seems more hopeless than ever - he becomes suicidal and also goes on a grueling hunger strike. And the chronically ill Hug also neglects herself so much under the pressure of the situation that her life hangs by a thread... / Zurich in den fruhen 1980er-Jahren: Die kampferische Anwaltin Barbara Hug will das Schweizer Justizsystem von Grund auf umkrempeln. Wahrend der Jugendunruhen - Stichwort "Zuri brennt" - vertritt sie rebellische Linksautonome wie das Punkmadchen Heike und nutzt das Gericht als Buhne, um auf die Missstande eines ruckstandigen Strafrechts aufmerksam zu machen. Eines Tages sucht der rebellische Sohn einer Industriellendynastie und Berufskriminelle Walter Sturm, gerade einmal wieder aus dem Gefangnis geflohen, ihren Rat. Der charismatische Sturm widerspricht allen Regeln, lebt bedingungslosen Egoismus und gerat dabei immer wieder mit dem System aneinander. Nicht nur Heike verfallt seinem schelmischen Charme, auch Barbara fuhlt sich zu ihrem Mandanten hingezogen.Ausgerechnet Sturm wird in linken Kreisen und in der Jugendbewegung zum Symbol fur Freiheit und die Wurde des Einzelnen - und damit zum Idol einer ganzen Generation. Als der "Ausbrecherkonig" auf der Flucht nach Istanbul erneut im Gefangnis landet, kommt er in Isolationshaft. Doch diesmal scheint die Lage aussichtsloser denn je - er wird suizidal und begibt sich zusatzlich in einen zermurbenden Hungerstreik. Und auch die chronisch kranke Hug vernachlassigt sich unter dem Druck der Situation so sehr, dass ihr Leben am seidenen Faden hangt ...

programme.title: The almost perfect man / Der fast perfekte Mann
programme.desc: TV talker Ulf Kramer (Benno Furmann) likes things to be perfect. The self-loving womanizer drives a cool sleigh, lives in a dust-free designer apartment and dreams of a great TV career. What will happen next with his girlfriend Anni (Jordis Triebel) is not the main focus of the egocentric man. She wanted to finally take the step into living together, but he didn't want to take on any responsibility. As soon as Anni has left the argument, his nephew Aaron (Louis Hofmann) shows up. The boy who was rejected by foster parents wants to stay with them, at least temporarily. But that's not an option for Ulf, who has little to do with his half-sister. After a short argument with youth welfare officer Doris (Maria Happel), he sends them both away again. But Aaron doesn't let himself be brushed off so easily and knows how to help himself with brutal means. So he can stay until a solution is found. Ulf now has to deal with a stubborn boy who speaks plainly and knows exactly what he wants. At the TV station, animal-loving Aaron causes real chaos when he takes a cat off the roof. So Ulf also has a problem with his chronically dissatisfied boss Norbert Henssler (Martin Brambach). He can't worry about his career because of Aaron. Especially since his sister, who had a serious accident, not only gave him responsibility for the boy, but also made a difficult decision. Right now he needed Anni, who is already being courted by her ex-boyfriend Gustav (Harald Schrott). / TV-Talker Ulf Kramer (Benno Furmann) mag es gerne perfekt. Der selbstverliebte Womanizer fahrt einen coolen Schlitten, lebt in einer staubfreien Designerwohnung und traumt von der groSSen TV-Karriere. Wie es mit Freundin Anni (Jordis Triebel) weitergehen soll, steht fur den Egozentriker nicht im Vordergrund. Sie mochte endlich den Schritt ins gemeinsame Leben machen, er aber keine Verantwortung ubernehmen. Kaum ist Anni im Streit gegangen, kreuzt sein Neffe Aaron (Louis Hofmann) auf. Der bei Pflegeeltern ausgebuxte Junge will ausgerechnet bei ihm unterkommen, zumindest ubergangsweise. Fur Ulf, der mit seiner Halbschwester wenig am Hut hat, ist das aber keine Option. Nach einem kurzen Wortgefecht mit Jugendamtsbetreuerin Doris (Maria Happel) schickt er beide wieder weg. Aber Aaron lasst sich nicht so einfach abwimmeln und weiSS sich auch mit rabiaten Mitteln zu helfen. Also kann er bleiben, bis eine Losung gefunden ist. Ulf muss nun mit einem storrischen Jungen zurechtkommen, der Klartext spricht und genau weiSS, was er will. Beim TV-Sender richtet der tierliebe Aaron ein richtiges Chaos an, als er eine Katze vom Dach holt. So bekommt Ulf auch noch ein Problem mit seinem chronisch unzufriedenen Chef Norbert Henssler (Martin Brambach). Um seine Karriere kann er sich wegen Aaron nicht kummern. Zumal ihm seine schwer verungluckte Schwester nicht nur die Verantwortung fur den Jungen, sondern auch eine schwere Entscheidung ubertragen hat. Gerade jetzt brauchte er Anni, die bereits von ihrem Ex Freund Gustav (Harald Schrott) umworben wird.

programme.title: Hubert without Staller / Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Hubert and Girwidz are called to a luxury hotel because of property damage. Apparently someone was rioting in the morning. But the person living in the room can no longer comment on this because he is lying dead in the bathroom. The murder weapon was quickly found, a razor with the name “Reimund Girwidz” engraved on it! The irritated police officers trace the trail of the knife and increasingly look behind the involvement of three jury members who are supposed to choose the winner of the beard championship that is taking place in the hotel. / Hubert und Girwidz werden wegen Sachbeschadigung in ein Luxushotel gerufen. Offenbar hat jemand morgens randaliert. Doch der Bewohner des Zimmers kann dazu keine Aussage mehr machen, denn er liegt tot im Badezimmer. Die irritierten Polizisten verfolgen die Spur des Messers zuruck und blicken zunehmend hinter die Verstrickungen dreier Jurymitglieder, die bei der im Hotel anstehenden Bartmeisterschaft den Gewinner kuren sollen.

programme.title: Only the elbe / WaPo Elbe
programme.desc: Open water swimmer Tim Lehmann drowns under dubious circumstances during training. The WaPo officers quickly realize that it is a homicide. The investigation went into the training camp, which was run with a hard hand by trainer Rowitz. Its eleven are entangled in a disastrous web of ambition, envy and misunderstood loyalty. In the end, the tragedy threatens to repeat itself if Maike, Jana and Moritz don't act quickly enough. / Beim Training ertrinkt der Freiwasserschwimmer Tim Lehmann unter dubiosen Umstanden. Am Ende droht sich die Tragodie zu wiederholen, wenn Maike, Jana und Moritz nicht schnell genug handeln.

programme.title: Master of everyday life / Meister des Alltags
programme.desc: Does baking soda help against stomach pain? Are red wine grapes predominantly grown in the Palatinate? And are the needle tips sterilized with alcohol beforehand during acupuncture treatments? These and many other exciting and curious questions about everyday life can be found in the SWR knowledge quiz! Moderator Florian Weber puts his prominent candidates' suitability for everyday use to the test in "Masters of Everyday Life". Cabaret artist Christoph Sonntag and actress Alice Hoffmann compete against comedian Bodo Bach and presenter Enie van de Meiklokjes. Creativity and inventiveness are required when guessing the tricky questions from everyday life. Both teams play for projects run by the Herzenssache children's charity - and the winning team's winnings are doubled! Today the donations go to the “One Number Against Grief” project in Kaiserslautern and to the “Grief Work with Children” project in Konstanz. / Hilft Natron gegen Magenschmerzen? Werden in der Pfalz uberwiegend Rotweintrauben angebaut? Und werden bei Akupunkturbehandlungen die Nadelspitzen vorher mit Alkohol sterilisiert? Diese und viele weitere spannende und kuriose Fragen rund um den ganz normalen Alltag gibt es im SWR-Wissensquiz! Moderator Florian Weber stellt in "Meister des Alltags" die Alltagstauglichkeit seiner prominenten Kandidaten auf die Probe. Kabarettist Christoph Sonntag und Schauspielerin Alice Hoffmann treten gegen Comedian Bodo Bach und Moderatorin Enie van de Meiklokjes an. Kreativitat und Ideenreichtum sind gefragt beim Erraten der kniffligen Fragen aus dem taglichen Leben. Beide Teams spielen jeweils fur Projekte der Kinderhilfsaktion Herzenssache - und die erspielte Summe des Siegerteams wird verdoppelt! Heute gehen die Spenden an das Projekt "Eine Nummer gegen Kummer" in Kaiserslautern sowie an das Projekt "Trauerarbeit mit Kindern" in Konstanz.

programme.title: Red roses / Rote Rosen
programme.desc: When Heiner finds an old cassette with Svenja's first self-written song, Arthur immediately gets a cassette recorder. But before the two can listen to the piece, the cassette accidentally falls into a pool. Arthur doesn't hesitate for a second and immediately jumps after him. Touched by this heroic act, Svenja makes a spontaneous decision. Britta comes across interesting information about Matteo on the Internet: He has five children from four women. Britta takes it easy, she just liked having fun with Matteo. After Michael and Carla find out that their western village has been destroyed by a tropical storm, Carla has to confess her green card misery to Michael. A heated argument breaks out. Can the two make up again? Mo receives the tempting offer to rent space in the perfume factory in Parma. Julius is ready to leave Luneburg and his family behind. Together they plan the step into a new future. But suddenly Julius becomes thoughtful... / Als Heiner eine alte Kassette mit Svenjas erstem selbstgeschriebenen Song wiederfindet, besorgt Arthur sofort einen Kassettenrekorder. Geruhrt von dieser heldenhaften Tat, fasst Svenja einen spontanen Entschluss.Britta stoSSt im Internet auf interessante Informationen uber Matteo: Er hat funf Kinder von vier Frauen. Britta nimmt es locker, sie mochte einfach nur SpaSS mit Matteo.Nachdem Michael und Carla von der Zerstorung ihres Westerndorfs durch einen Tropensturm erfahren haben, muss Carla Michael ihre Greencard-Misere beichten. Es kommt zu einem heftigen Streit. Konnen die beiden sich wieder versohnen?Mo erhalt das verlockende Angebot, Raume in der Parfum-Manufaktur in Parma zu mieten. Julius ist bereit, Luneburg und seine Familie hinter sich zu lassen. Gemeinsam planen sie den Schritt in eine neue Zukunft. Doch plotzlich wird Julius nachdenklich ...

programme.title: Storm of love / Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Yannik's brother Kilian comes to Bichlheim unexpectedly and explains that after his last job as a star chef he now wants to go on vacation here. Meanwhile, Fanny realizes that she doesn't need romantic relationships to experience closeness and friendship. But then she tries a dessert from Kilian and is completely enchanted...When Anja learns with admiration about Helene's spontaneous departure on an adventure, she feels an inner restlessness. Then Alfons gives her his already unpopular fitness lesson with Lale, maybe Anja can relax after some physical activity? Overcoming a small fear then makes it clear to her that she can also overcome a bigger fear. Christoph realizes that he can only finance Alexandra's shares, and Werner is surprised to realize that Christoph never wanted to divide the shares equally between them. It becomes clear to him: Now that the enemy from outside has been defeated, the old fight between him and Christoph is revived. / Yanniks Bruder Kilian kommt uberraschend nach Bichlheim und erklart, dass er nach seiner letzten Anstellung als Sternekoch nun hier Urlaub machen will. In der Zwischenzeit erkennt Fanny, dass sie keine romantischen Beziehungen braucht, um Nahe und Freundschaft zu erleben. Doch dann probiert sie ein Dessert von Kilian und ist vollkommen verzaubert ...Als Anja voller Bewunderung von Helenes spontanem Aufbruch ins Abenteuer erfahrt, verspurt sie selbst eine innere Unruhe. Da gibt Alfons ihr seine ohnehin ungeliebte Fitnessstunde bei Lale ab, vielleicht kommt Anja nach korperlicher Aktivitat zur Ruhe? Die Überwindung einer kleinen Angst macht ihr dann klar, dass sie auch eine groSSere Angst meistern kann.Christoph merkt, dass er nur Alexandras Anteile finanzieren kann, und Werner kommt uberrumpelt zur Erkenntnis, dass Christoph die Anteile nie gleichwertig zwischen ihnen aufteilen wollte. Ihm wird klar: Nachdem der Feind von auSSen nun besiegt ist, lebt der alte Kampf zwischen ihm und Christoph wieder auf.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Boxing trainer Volker "Voller" Karak is found dead under a dumbbell stand in his club by 17-year-old Nuray Demir. Nuray, along with Leonie, who is the same age, is one of the club's biggest boxing talents. Both girls qualified for the North German Championships under “Voller’s” wing. At the crime scene, detectives Finn Kiesewetter, Lars Englen and Nina Weiss question the young athletes who are visibly affected by the death of their coach. In the middle of their interrogation, Nuray's older brother Kadir bursts into anger. The aircraft engineer makes no secret of the fact that he doesn't think much of the club's environment and would prefer to ban his sister from boxing. Inspector Gregor Michalski finds out that there had recently been a heated argument between Kadir and "Voller". The reason: The social worker Britta Munzer accused the coach of sexual assault. But she didn't want to tell the police about anyone injured or witnesses. Did Kadir then take the law into his own hands? / Boxtrainer Volker "Voller" Karak wird von der 17-jahrigen Nuray Demir unter einem Hantelstander tot in seinem Club aufgefunden. Nuray gehort mit der gleichaltrigen Leonie zu den groSSen Boxtalenten des Vereins. Beide Madchen qualifizierten sich unter "Vollers" Fittichen fur die Norddeutsche Meisterschaft. Am Tatort vernehmen die Kommissare Finn Kiesewetter, Lars Englen und Nina Weiss die jungen Sportlerinnen, die vom Tod ihres Trainers sichtlich betroffen sind. Mitten in ihre Vernehmung platzt voller Wut Nurays alterer Bruder Kadir. Der Flugzeugingenieur macht keinen Hehl daraus, dass er vom Milieu des Clubs wenig halt und seiner Schwester das Boxen am liebsten verbieten wurde. Kommissar Gregor Michalski findet heraus, dass es zwischen Kadir und "Voller" vor kurzem zu einem heftigen Streit gekommen war. Der Grund: Die Sozialarbeiterin Britta Munzer beschuldigte den Coach sexueller Übergriffe. Bei der Polizei wollte sie aber weder Geschadigte noch Zeugen nennen. Hat Kadir daraufhin das Recht in die eigene Hand genommen?

programme.title: Knowledge before eight - future / Wissen vor acht - Zukunft
programme.desc: Australian researchers attached human neurons to a semiconductor board and had them learn the video game "Pong." Surprisingly, human brain cells learned the game in five minutes, while a microchip-based AI took over an hour. Anja Reschke explains in "Knowledge before eight - future" why human nerve cells were better and what that means for the development of new AI systems. / Australische Forscher haben menschliche Neuronen auf einer Halbleiterplatte angebracht und sie das Videospiel "Pong" lernen lassen. Überraschenderweise lernten die menschlichen Gehirnzellen das Spiel in funf Minuten, wahrend eine KI auf Mikrochip-Basis uber eine Stunde brauchte. Warum die menschlichen Nervenzellen besser waren und was das fur die Entwicklung neuer KI-Systeme bedeutet, erklart Anja Reschke in "Wissen vor acht - Zukunft".
