If it's important, it's on Telejornal. / A mais rigorosa seleçao de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. De segunda a domingo, Joao Adelino Faria, Jose Rodrigues dos Santos e Ana Lourenço mostram-lhe o que de mais relevante se passou o país e no mundo. Se e importante está no Telejornal.

programme.title: Spies / Espias
programme.desc: Miss Black is determined to find the mole at the English embassy. Meanwhile, William Larenz meets with Rose, communicating new results from one of his most successful spies, Ema Delmont, who runs a complex spy network in Europe. / Miss Black está determinada em encontar a toupeira da embaixada inglesa. Entretanto, William Larenz encontra-se com Rose, comunicando novos resultados de uma das suas mais bem-sucedidas espias, Ema Delmont, que gere uma complexa rede de espionagem na Europa.

programme.title: Joker / Joker
programme.desc: Vasco Palmeirim presents JOKER, the Portuguese's favorite contest. A competitor, with the help of 7 Jokers and the Super Joker, answers 12 questions with just one goal in mind: Win the 50,000 euros maximum prize! / Vasco Palmeirim apresenta o JOKER, o concurso favorito dos portugueses. Um concorrente, com a ajuda de 7 Jokers e do Super Joker, responde a 12 perguntas com um so objetivo em mente: Conquistar os 50 000 euros do premio máximo!

programme.title: The Extraordinary Journey of the Portuguese Community of France / O Extraordinário Percurso da Comunidade Portuguesa de França
programme.desc: It's a practically unknown story, rarely covered on television. On October 16, 1916, the first labor agreement was signed between France and Portugal. / É uma historia praticamente desconhecida, raramente abordada em televisao. No dia 16 de outubro de 1916 foi assinado o primeiro acordo de mao-de-obra entre a França e Portugal.

programme.title: Festival F - Concerto Tiago Nacarato and Orquestra Bamba Social / Festival F - Concerto Tiago Nacarato and Orquestra Bamba Social
programme.desc: The Last Great Summer Festival took place on the 4th, 5th, 6th and 7th of September 2025 in the historic center of Faro. Tiago Nacarato and Orquestra Bamba Social gave a concert on Palco Se, one of the seven stages that make up Festival F. / O Último Grande Festival de Verao aconteceu nos dias 4, 5, 6 e 7 de setembro de 2025 no centro historico de Faro. Tiago Nacarato and Orquestra Bamba Social deram um concerto no Palco Se, um dos sete palcos que compõem o Festival F.

programme.title: Ideological shock / Choque Ideologico
S.W.A.T.: Intervention Force / S.W.A.T.: Força de Intervençao
programme.desc: A cop about to shut down a major drug operation is kidnapped, Hondo and the squad race to save one of their own before it's too late. Luca becomes concerned about sudden changes in Hicks' behavior. / Um polícia prestes a encerrar uma grande operaçao de drogas e sequestrado, Hondo e o esquadrao correm para salvar um dos seus antes que seja tarde demais. Luca fica preocupado com mudanças repentinas no comportamento de Hicks.

programme.title: Balacobaco / Balacobaco
programme.desc: Isabel is a successful architect who sees her life fall apart when she discovers that her husband, Danilo, lost everything in gambling and illegal schemes, in addition to her sister dying in a mysterious accident, leaving her with custody of her niece Taís. / Isabel e uma arquiteta bem sucedida que ve sua vida ruir quando descobre que seu marido, Danilo, perdeu tudo em jogos de azar e esquemas ilegais, alem de sua irma morrer em um acidente misterioso, deixando-a com a guarda da sobrinha Taís.

programme.title: Our Afternoon / A Nossa Tarde
programme.desc: Discover the more emotional side of Tânia Ribas de Oliveira in RTP's new afternoon program. / Conheça o lado mais emocional de Tânia Ribas de Oliveira no novo programa das tardes da RTP.

programme.title: Telesales / Televendas
programme.desc: Every day, a space dedicated to television sales, where product demonstrations are given. / Todos os dias, um espaço dedicado a vendas por televisao, em que sao feitas demonstrações dos produtos.

programme.title: Good Morning Portugal / Bom Dia Portugal
programme.desc: Because the day begins in the morning, so start it in our company! Every day, «Bom dia Portugal» dedicates specific spaces to current national and international news, sport, weather, traffic and economy. / Porque e de manha que se começa o dia, entao inicie-o na nossa companhia! Todos os dias, o «Bom dia Portugal» dedica espaços específicos às notícias da atualidade nacional e internacional, desporto, meteorologia, trânsito e economia.

programme.title: Joy Square / Praça da Alegria
programme.desc: Praça da Alegria will bring you the best music, the latest fashion trends, useful advice and new tips that make your daily life easier. All of Portugal will be present at this program! / A Praça da Alegria vai levar ate si a melhor música, as últimas tendencias da moda, conselhos úteis e novas dicas que facilitam o seu dia-a-dia. Portugal inteiro vai marcar presença neste programa!

programme.title: Afternoon Newspaper / Jornal da Tarde
programme.desc: Every day, at 1pm, your lunch hour is completed with updates on national and global news, from politics, economics, society and not forgetting sport. With Jornal da Tarde, be well informed about what is happening in the country and the world! / Todos os dias, às 13h, a sua hora de almoço e completada com a atualizaçao das notícias que marcam a atualidade nacional e mundial, desde a política, a economia, a sociedade e sem esquecer o desporto. Com o Jornal da Tarde, esteja bem informado sobre o que acontece no país e no mundo!

programme.title: Lucky Time: Classic Lottery / Hora da Sorte: Lotaria Clássica
programme.desc: On Mondays a special broadcast that includes the extraction of the Classic Lottery lucky numbers. / Às segundas-feiras uma emissao especial que inclui a extraçao dos números da sorte da Lotaria Clássica.

programme.title: Balacobaco / Balacobaco
programme.desc: Isabel is a successful architect who sees her life fall apart when she discovers that her husband, Danilo, lost everything in gambling and illegal schemes, in addition to her sister dying in a mysterious accident, leaving her with custody of her niece Taís. / Isabel e uma arquiteta bem sucedida que ve sua vida ruir quando descobre que seu marido, Danilo, perdeu tudo em jogos de azar e esquemas ilegais, alem de sua irma morrer em um acidente misterioso, deixando-a com a guarda da sobrinha Taís.

programme.title: Our Afternoon / A Nossa Tarde
programme.desc: Discover the more emotional side of Tânia Ribas de Oliveira in RTP's new afternoon program. / Conheça o lado mais emocional de Tânia Ribas de Oliveira no novo programa das tardes da RTP.

programme.title: Portugal on Network / Portugal em Rede
programme.desc: Information program focused on the country and regions. It aims to reveal the Portugal that exists beyond the big cities, from the north to the south and the islands, in a true information network. Includes a segment dedicated to the Portuguese language and its promotion "This language that unites us". The Regional Information Centers will have a relevant participation in this space, where Portuguese society, culture, history and traditions will always be present. / Programa de informaçao centrado no país e nas regiões. Pretende revelar o Portugal que existe para alem das grandes cidades, do norte ao sul e às ilhas, numa verdadeira rede de informaçao. Inclui um segmento dedicado à língua portuguesa e à sua promoçao "Esta língua que nos une". Os Centros de Informaçao Regional terao uma participaçao relevante neste espaço, onde a sociedade, cultura, historia e tradições portuguesas vao estar sempre presentes.

programme.title: News / Telejornal
programme.desc: The most rigorous selection of news, every day at 8 pm. From Monday to Sunday, Joao Adelino Faria, Jose Rodrigues dos Santos and Ana Lourenço show you the most relevant events in the country and around the world. If it's important, it's on Telejornal. / A mais rigorosa seleçao de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. De segunda a domingo, Joao Adelino Faria, Jose Rodrigues dos Santos e Ana Lourenço mostram-lhe o que de mais relevante se passou o país e no mundo. Se e importante está no Telejornal.

programme.title: Olhares - Afro-descendants in Contemporary Portugal / Olhares - Afrodescendentes no Portugal Contemporâneo
programme.desc: This episode asks different people of African descent, of different ages, from different cultural backgrounds and of both genders, what the role of African descent means and how they live it. / Este episodio indaga junto de diferentes afrodescendentes, de diferentes idades, de diferentes meios culturais e de ambos generos, o que significa e como vivem na pele o papel de afrodescendente.

programme.title: Jungles of the World / Selvas do Mundo
programme.desc: The most incredible forests and jungles in the world in a 26-episode documentary series. A trip around the world to discover the abundant biodiversity that the last great forests and jungles on the planet are home to: from the strangest inhabitants to the most beautiful and unexplored regions. / As florestas e selvas mais incríveis do mundo numa serie documental de 26 episodios. Uma viagem à volta do mundo à descoberta da abundante biodiversidade que as últimas grandes florestas e selvas do planeta albergam: desde os habitantes mais estranhos ate às regiões mais belas e inexploradas.

programme.title: Room Sheet / Folha de Sala
programme.desc: A cultural agenda that highlights theater, music and other shows, not forgetting the launch of books and records, cinema and other events, such as exhibitions, open-air shows and conferences. Text and voiceover by Manuela Silva Reis. / Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, nao esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realizaçao de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferencias. Texto e locuçao de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: I'll Give You All This / Dar-te-ei Tudo Isto
programme.desc: Manuel, a famous Parisian writer, discovers that Aymeric, her husband, has just died in a car accident near Aix-en-Provence. / Manuel, um famoso escritor parisiense, descobre que Aymeric, o seu marido, acaba de falecer num acidente de carro perto de Aix-en-Provence.

programme.title: Newspaper 2 / Jornal 2
programme.desc: The world in 30 minutes. In Jornal 2 we analyze facts and cross-reference opinions. With each passing day we read the country and the world with data, explanations and interpretations in the most diverse areas, such as Politics, Science, Economy and Culture. / O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. A cada dia que passa fazemos leitura do país e do mundo com dados, explicações e interpretações nas mais diversas áreas, como Política, Ciencia, Economia e Cultura.

programme.title: Kafka / Kafka
programme.desc: The first episode is about Kafka's friend, Max Brod. He is a renowned writer, full of energy and ideas, but his biggest project is achieving fame for his friend Franz. / O primeiro episodio e sobre o amigo de Kafka, Max Brod. Ele e um escritor reconhecido, cheio de energia e ideias, mas o seu maior projeto e alcançar a fama para o seu amigo Franz.

programme.title: Jakub Jozef Orlinski: Faces of Love / Jakub Jozef Orlinski: Facce dAmore
programme.desc: "Facce dAmore" is the second solo album by Polish countertenor Jakub Jozef Orlinski. All the songs tell a story, which illustrates the male figure of the Baroque period, not only the positive aspect such as the pleasure of mutual love, but also anger and even madness. / "Facce dAmore" e o segundo álbum a solo do contratenor polaco Jakub Jozef Orlinski. Todas as canções contam uma historia, que ilustra a figura masculina da epoca barroca, nao apenas o aspeto positivo como o prazer do amor mútuo, mas tambem a raiva e ate a loucura.

programme.title: Citizen's Voice / Voz do Cidadao
programme.desc: Program under the responsibility of the Viewer's Ombudsman, being shown regularly across all channels of the Public Television Service, reflects the treatment of the most significant cases brought to the attention of the Provider by viewers each week. / Programa da responsabilidade do Provedor do Telespectador, sendo exibido regularmente atraves de todos os canais do Serviço Público de Televisao, reflete o tratamento dos casos mais significativos trazidos à apreciaçao do Provedor pelos telespetadores em cada semana.

programme.title: American Capitalism: The Cult of Wealth / Capitalismo Americano: O Culto da Riqueza
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century, a club of millionaires - John D. Rockefeller and his oil monopoly, the steel king and philanthropist Andrew Carnegie or the banker J. P. Morgan who, from Wall Street, financed the industrial revolution - emerged from America. / No final do seculo XIX, um clube de milionários - John D. Rockefeller e o seu monopolio petrolífero, o rei do aço e filantropo Andrew Carnegie ou o banqueiro J. P. Morgan que, a partir de Wall Street, financiou a revoluçao industrial - emergiu da America.

programme.title: Cinemax / Cinemax
programme.desc: Cinemax is a program dedicated to the universe of short films and the relevance of this format in discovering new talents and valuing classic authors. Cinemax guarantees the regular screening of short films, complemented by brief interviews that introduce their authors. / Cinemax e um programa dedicado ao universo da curta-metragem e à relevância deste formato na descoberta de novos talentos e valorizaçao de autores clássicos. O Cinemax garante a exibiçao regular de curtas-metragens, complementada por breves entrevistas que apresentam os seus autores.

programme.title: Deadly Heatstroke / Insolaçao Mortal
programme.desc: Ted and Amanda's intense work finally shows results and Jong Min's remains are found in the river. Amanda is convinced that there is a connection between this death and that of her friend Lars. / O intenso trabalho de Ted e Amanda finalmente mostra resultados e sao encontrados no rio os restos mortais de Jong Min. Amanda está convencida de que há uma ligaçao entre esta morte e a do seu amigo Lars.

programme.title: Sergio Varella Cid - A Prodigy on a Razor's Edge / Sergio Varella Cid - Um Prodígio no Fio da Navalha
programme.desc: Sergio Varella Cid, a piano prodigy since he was 3 years old, was compared to Mozart. At 15, he moved to London, facing challenges and opportunities. With talent and a taste for risk, he became one of the greatest international pianists. / Sergio Varella Cid, prodígio do piano desde os 3 anos, foi comparado a Mozart. Aos 15, mudou-se para Londres, enfrentando desafios e oportunidades. Com talento e gosto pelo risco, tornou-se um dos maiores pianistas internacionais.

programme.title: Another Goa / Outra Goa
programme.desc: The social atmosphere is captured, in interviews with the generations that lived through Portuguese colonialism and the transition to the Indian nation and those that live in post-colonial Goa, whose rhythms we will follow and whose forms of sociability we will record. / A atmosfera social e captada, em entrevistas com as gerações que viveram o colonialismo portugues e a transiçao para a naçao indiana e as que vivem a Goa pos-colonial, cujos ritmos acompanharemos e cujas formas de sociabilidade registaremos.

programme.title: On the Edge of the Deep Sea / À Beira do Mar Profundo
programme.desc: During the month of July 2018, the Madeira Oceanic Observatory carried out another scientific expedition, this time to explore the deep and unknown areas adjacent to Madeira Island. / Durante o mes de Julho de 2018, o Observatorio Oceânico da Madeira levou a cabo mais uma expediçao científica, desta vez para explorar as zonas profundas e desconhecidas adjacentes à Ilha da Madeira.

programme.title: ABC Law / ABC Direito
programme.desc: Public service program, which functions as a manual on the laws of life. Through an original, artistic and informative format, each episode aims to inform citizens about their rights and responsibilities under Portuguese law. / Programa de serviço público, que funciona como um manual de leis da vida. Atraves de um formato original, artístico e informativo, cada episodio tem como objetivo informar os cidadaos sobre os seus direitos e responsabilidades ao abrigo da lei portuguesa.

programme.title: Sea of ​​Letters / Mar de Letras
programme.desc: His name is Eugenio Costa Almeida, but when it comes to signing his poetic work, he returns to his origins and signs as Lobitino Almeida Ngola, a literary pseudonym that derives from the land where he was born: Lobito. "Mazuí - poems, stories and other words" is his first poetic work. / Chama-se Eugenio Costa Almeida mas na hora de assinar a sua obra poetica regressa às origens e assina como Lobitino Almeida Ngola, um pseudonimo literário que deriva da terra que o viu nasceu: o Lobito. "Mazuí - poesias, contos e outras palavras" e a sua primeira obra poetica.

programme.title: Paths / Caminhos
programme.desc: Weekly informative program dedicated to the activities of the different Churches represented in Portugal. In addition to addressing the religious activities inherent to each one, «Caminhos» also has a social concern, dealing with topics of interest to today's society. / Programa informativo semanal dedicado às atividades das diversas Igrejas representadas em Portugal. Para alem de abordar as atividades religiosas inerentes a cada uma, «Caminhos» tem tambem uma preocupaçao social, tratando temas de interesse para a sociedade atual.

programme.title: We have a program / Temos Programa
programme.desc: We have a program and a TV poster dedicated only to RTP2's programming, in other words, we're really going to turn the heat on our sardines. It is broadcast every Sunday at 7pm and we will go on a journey from Monday to Sunday highlighting the programs we want viewers not to miss. / Temos programa e um cartaz TV dedicado apenas à programaçao da RTP2, ou seja, vamos mesmo puxar a brasa à nossa sardinha. É emitido todos os domingos pelas 19.00 e faremos uma viagem de segunda a domingo destacando os programas que queremos que os telespectadores nao percam.

programme.title: Tommy the Little Dragon / Tommy, o Pequeno Dragao
programme.desc: Tommy is a stuffed animal who lives with a family of pandas. With the help of his magical soap bubbles, Tommy takes children on wonderful adventures to help them discover a vast and captivating world, combat their fears and inhibitions and learn family values. / Tommy e um peluche que vive com uma família de pandas. Com a ajuda das suas bolhas de sabao mágicas, Tommy leva as crianças a viver aventuras maravilhosas para ajudá-las a descobrir um mundo vasto e cativante, a combater os seus medos e inibições e a aprender valores familiares.

programme.title: Robocar Poly / Robocar Poli
programme.desc: In Broom, a small village with a strong rescue team, there are always accidents and problems such as a car crashing into a ravine on a rainy day, a child locked in a house, among other dangerous situations. In each episode, the village's rescue team saves some of the inhabitants. / Em Broom, uma pequena vila com uma forte equipa de resgate, existem sempre acidentes e problemas como um carro que se despista numa ravina num dia de chuva, uma criança fechada numa casa, entre outras situações de perigo. Em cada episodio, a equipa de resgate da vila salva alguns dos habitantes.

programme.title: Bing / Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny is a series based on children's books by author and illustrator Ted Dewan. It celebrates the realities, learning and adventure of being a preschooler when life is full of everyday dramas for both children and adults. / Bing Bunny e uma serie baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pre-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: Ana Ladina / Ana Ladina
programme.desc: Ana Ladina is a very mischievous and mischievous 5-year-old girl who finds it really fun to look for Ladina solutions for her daily adventures, sometimes surprising, but always fun! / Ana Ladina e uma menina de 5 anos, muito traquinas e marota que acha muito divertido procurar soluções ladinas para as suas aventuras diárias, por vezes surpreendentes, mas sempre divertidas!

programme.title: Ana Ladina / Ana Ladina
programme.desc: Ana Ladina is a very mischievous and mischievous 5-year-old girl who finds it really fun to look for Ladina solutions for her daily adventures, sometimes surprising, but always fun! / Ana Ladina e uma menina de 5 anos, muito traquinas e marota que acha muito divertido procurar soluções ladinas para as suas aventuras diárias, por vezes surpreendentes, mas sempre divertidas!

programme.title: Gus the Minorca Knight / Gus, o Cavaleiro Minorca
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a little boy, Gus, who wanted to be a great knight. Sorry, not a great knight... The greatest knight in the entire kingdom of Karamel. The problem is that Gus is... minorca! He's three apples tall, but he has a heart the size of a house! / Era uma vez um rapazinho, Gus, que queria ser um grande cavaleiro. Desculpem, nao um grande cavaleiro... O maior cavaleiro de todo o reino de Karamel. O problema e que Gus e... minorca! Ele tem tres maças de altura, mas tem um coraçao do tamanho de uma casa!

programme.title: Petit / Petit
programme.desc: Discover Petit's unique and imaginative perspective on everyday situations that become fantastic adventures that he will live together with his friends. Based on the award-winning book "Petit El Monstruo" by Isol. / Descubra a perspetiva única e imaginativa de Petit sobre situações do quotidiano que se tornam aventuras fantásticas que ele irá viver, juntamente com os seus amigos. Baseado no premiado livro "Petit El Monstruo" de Isol.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings / Grizzy E Os Lemingues
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover an archaic indigenous table with the power to reveal the past and relive the first confrontations of their prehistoric ancestors and discover that chocolate spread was invented a long, long time ago. / Grizzy e os Lemingues descobrem uma mesa indígena arcaica com o poder de mostrar o passado e revivem os primeiros confrontos dos seus ancestrais pre-historicos e descobrem que o chocolate de barrar foi inventado há muito, muito tempo.

programme.title: Radar XS / Radar XS
programme.desc: Radar XS is a news program for children aged 8 to 12 that aims to encourage critical thinking and conscious citizenship. We will bring together politics and culture, economics and sport, science and children's literature, national and international current affairs in a simple and objective language. / Radar XS e um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciencia e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.title: Superhero Academy / Academia de Super-Herois
programme.desc: A group of teenagers attend a special school for future superheroes where they try to master deadly obstacle courses and create their own super costumes! / Um grupo de adolescentes frequenta uma escola especial para futuros super-herois onde tentam dominar pistas de obstáculos mortais e criar as suas proprias super-roupas!

programme.title: Always Late / Sempre Atrasados
programme.desc: Every morning, Nuno and Malika leave home 30 minutes early to go to school and they still arrive late every morning! This is because every morning, something incredible happens along the way. But even though their stories are always true, the school principal never believes them... / Todas as manhas, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhas chegam atrasados! Isto porque todas as manhas, algo incrível acontece no caminho. Mas mesmo que as suas historias sejam sempre verdadeiras, a diretora da escola nunca acredita nelas...

programme.title: School of Heroes / Escola de Herois
programme.desc: Hero School is a school for budding superheroes, where children learn to master their innate powers to help people, solve problems and try to make the world a better place. / A Escola de Herois e uma escola para super-herois principiantes, onde as crianças aprendem a dominar os seus poderes inatos para ajudar as pessoas, resolver problemas e tentar tornar o mundo num lugar melhor.

programme.title: Lobito's Tales / Os Contos do Lobito
programme.desc: Lobito dreams of being like the heroes of the storybooks he loves to read, traveling from story to story to live their adventures. But as the intrepid little wolf quickly discovers, reaching a happy ending is no easy task and he will have to learn from his mistakes. / Lobito sonha ser como os herois dos livros de historias que mais gosta de ler, viajando de conto em conto para viver as suas aventuras. Mas como o intrepido lobinho depressa descobre, chegar ao final feliz nao e tarefa fácil e terá de aprender com os seus erros.

programme.title: Rev and Roll / Rev and Roll
programme.desc: Join Rev, an 8-year-old boy, and his best friend, Rumble, a boisterous and powerful truck who thinks he's a dog, and live big, fun adventures with them in their hometown of Fender Bend! / Junta-te Rev, um menino de 8 anos, e ao seu melhor amigo, Rumble, um camiao turbulento e poderoso que pensa que e um cachorro, e vive com eles grandes e divertidas aventuras na sua cidade natal, Fender Bend!

programme.title: A Escola dos Roaridos / A Escola dos Rugidos
programme.desc: Going to school for the first time is one of the biggest challenges we have to face. Roaring School helps children prepare for school life by exploring a child's first year through the relationships and experiences of our mini monsters. / Ir para a escola pela primeira vez e um dos maiores desafios que temos de enfrentar. A Escola dos Rugidos ajuda as crianças a prepararem-se para a vida escolar explorando o primeiro ano da criança atraves dos relacionamentos e experiencias dos nossos mini monstros.

programme.title: Numberblocks / Numberblocks
programme.desc: Numberblocks are a really fun group of numbers that work together to solve big and small problems and will teach you to count in a really fun way! / Os Numberblocks sao um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vao ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Kiwi / Kiwi
programme.desc: Let's learn English with Twiki and Twini! Each episode will be an adventure to discover new words and new sounds. / Vamos aprender Ingles com Twiki e Twini! Cada episodio será uma aventura para descobrir novas palavras e novos sons.

programme.title: The Great Discovery / A Grande Descoberta
programme.desc: Hugo, like all children, has a curious personality, and constantly questions himself on a journey in search of knowledge, logic and understanding the meaning of things. / Hugo, tal como todas as crianças, tem uma personalidade curiosa, e questiona-se constantemente numa jornada em busca de conhecimento, da logica e de compreender o significado das coisas.

programme.title: Ziggy and the Zootram / Ziggy and the Zootram
programme.desc: Ziggy is a friendly freshwater crocodile from Australia. He and his friends live in their eccentric houses located in a crater on an island. Ziggy and his friends have a very special secret - besides walking like people, talking like people - they all work in a zoo! / Ziggy e um simpático crocodilo-de-água-doce da Austrália. Ele e os seus amigos vivem nas suas excentricas casas situadas numa cratera de uma ilha. Ziggy e os seus amigos tem um segredo muito especial - alem de andarem como gente, falarem como gente - todos trabalham num jardim zoologico!

programme.title: Dimitri / Dimitri
programme.desc: Dimitri, a small bird, was lost from his family during migration and now roams the African continent, very different from his home continent, Europe. Deprived of his family and friends, Dimitri learns to overcome his fears to explore the extraordinary world of the savannah. / Dimitri, um pequeno pássaro, perdeu-se da sua família durante a migraçao e agora vagueia pelo continente africano, muito diferente do seu continente natal, a Europa. programme.desc: Lobito dreams of being like the heroes of the storybooks he loves to read, traveling from story to story to live their adventures. But as the intrepid little wolf quickly discovers, reaching a happy ending is no easy task and he will have to learn from his mistakes. / Lobito sonha ser como os herois dos livros de historias que mais gosta de ler, viajando de conto em conto para viver as suas aventuras. Mas como o intrepido lobinho depressa descobre, chegar ao final feliz nao e tarefa fácil e terá de aprender com os seus erros.

programme.title: Rev and Roll / Rev and Roll
programme.desc: Join Rev, an 8-year-old boy, and his best friend, Rumble, a boisterous and powerful truck who thinks he's a dog, and live big, fun adventures with them in their hometown of Fender Bend! / Junta-te Rev, um menino de 8 anos, e ao seu melhor amigo, Rumble, um camiao turbulento e poderoso que pensa que e um cachorro, e vive com eles grandes e divertidas aventuras na sua cidade natal, Fender Bend!

programme.title: A Escola dos Roaridos / A Escola dos Rugidos
programme.desc: Going to school for the first time is one of the biggest challenges we have to face. Roaring School helps children prepare for school life by exploring a child's first year through the relationships and experiences of our mini monsters. / Ir para a escola pela primeira vez e um dos maiores desafios que temos de enfrentar. A Escola dos Rugidos ajuda as crianças a prepararem-se para a vida escolar explorando o primeiro ano da criança atraves dos relacionamentos e experiencias dos nossos mini monstros.

programme.title: Numberblocks / Numberblocks
programme.desc: Numberblocks are a really fun group of numbers that work together to solve big and small problems and will teach you to count in a really fun way! / Os Numberblocks sao um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vao ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Kiwi / Kiwi
programme.desc: Let's learn English with Twiki and Twini! Each episode will be an adventure to discover new words and new sounds. / Vamos aprender Ingles com Twiki e Twini! Cada episodio será uma aventura para descobrir novas palavras e novos sons.

programme.title: The Great Discovery / A Grande Descoberta
programme.desc: Hugo, like all children, has a curious personality, and constantly questions himself on a journey in search of knowledge, logic and understanding the meaning of things. / Hugo, tal como todas as crianças, tem uma personalidade curiosa, e questiona-se constantemente numa jornada em busca de conhecimento, da logica e de compreender o significado das coisas.

programme.title: Ziggy and the Zootram / Ziggy and the Zootram
programme.desc: Ziggy is a friendly freshwater crocodile from Australia. He and his friends live in their eccentric houses located in a crater on an island. Ziggy and his friends have a very special secret - besides walking like people, talking like people - they all work in a zoo! / Ziggy e um simpático crocodilo-de-água-doce da Austrália. Ele e os seus amigos vivem nas suas excentricas casas situadas numa cratera de uma ilha. Ziggy e os seus amigos tem um segredo muito especial - alem de andarem como gente, falarem como gente - todos trabalham num jardim zoologico!

programme.title: Dimitri / Dimitri
programme.desc: Dimitri, a small bird, was lost from his family during migration and now roams the African continent, very different from his home continent, Europe. Deprived of his family and friends, Dimitri learns to overcome his fears to explore the extraordinary world of the savannah. / Dimitri, um pequeno pássaro, perdeu-se da sua família durante a migraçao e agora vagueia pelo continente africano, muito diferente do seu continente natal, a Europa. Privado da sua família e amigos, Dimitri aprende a superar os seus medos para explorar o mundo extraordinário da savana.

programme.title: Mia Go / Mia Go
programme.desc: Mia is a girl whose enthusiasm infects everyone around her. With her fearless sense of adventure, she tries things for the first time with a fearless attitude. Mia lives in the busy city Everyday with her closest friends and together they go on great adventures. / Mia e uma menina cujo entusiasmo contagia todos ao seu redor. Com seu destemido sentido de aventura, ela tenta as coisas pela primeira vez com uma atitude destemida. Mia mora na movimentada cidade Todososdias com os seus amigos mais proximos e juntos vao viver grandes aventuras.

programme.title: The Art of Healing / A Arte da Cura
programme.sub-title: Como nos Curam no Tempo, a Arte e a Ciencia
programme.desc: In the beginning, medicine was magical. The darkness of the night was feared, nature was venerated. Illness was a punishment from the Gods, and only a few had the power to heal. Buddha, Imhothep, Hippocrates, Galen, are the references. / Nos primordios, a medicina era mágica. Temia-se a escuridao da noite, a natureza era venerada. A doença era castigo dos Deuses, e so alguns detinham o poder da cura. Buda, Imhothep, Hipocrates, Galeno, sao as referencias.

programme.title: Marconi, the Man who United the World / Marconi, o Homem que Uniu o Mundo
programme.desc: 1937. In a climate of international tension, the fascist regime expects Guglielmo Marconi to contribute to the creation of a new weapon. A journalist is sent to discover their plans. / 1937. No clima de tensao internacional, o regime fascista espera que Guglielmo Marconi contribua para a criaçao de uma nova arma. Uma jornalista e enviada para descobrir os seus planos.

programme.title: Come Rain Come Sunshine / Faça Chuva Faça Sol
programme.desc: In the 1960s and 1970s Portugal was self-sufficient in hop production, today it only produces around 5% of its needs. Discover this raw material that is responsible for the bitter taste of traditional beer. The hop flower grows in the lands of Bragança and Braga. / Na decada de 1960 e 1970 Portugal era autossuficiente na produçao de lúpulo, hoje produz apenas cerca de 5% das suas necessidades. Conheça esta materia-prima que e responsável pelo travo amargo da cerveja tradicional. A flor de lúpulo cresce nas terras de Bragança e Braga.

programme.title: Do yare to laponia / Do Algarve à Laponia
programme.desc: From the Nordic countries to the Mediterranean, passing through the Balkan region, the program will reveal projects that have received European funds in areas as diverse as agriculture, job creation, new energy sources, combating poverty, climate change and the integration of refugees. / Dos países nordicos ao mediterrâneo, passando pela regiao dos balcas, o programa vai revelar projetos que receberam fundos europeus em áreas tao diversas como a agricultura, a criaçao de emprego, as novas fontes de energia, o combate à pobreza, as alterações climáticas e a integraçao de refugiados.

programme.desc: Sociedade Civil is a program with History that wants to be increasingly part of the daily lives of all Portuguese people. These are public issues debated by different people, private themes presented clearly. Presented by journalist Luís Castro, from Monday to Friday, at 2 pm. / O Sociedade Civil e um programa com Historia que quer fazer cada vez mais parte do dia-a-dia de todos os portugueses. Sao questões públicas debatidas por gente distinta, temas particulares apresentados de forma clara. Apresentado pelo jornalista Luís Castro, de segunda a sexta-feira, às 14h00.

programme.desc: Space dedicated to the different religions recognized in Portugal and established through its own Church. / Espaço dedicado às diferentes religiões reconhecidas em Portugal e instituídas atraves de uma Igreja propria.

programme.desc: A year after April 25th, autonomy reached the Azores, a region with its own unique heritage identity. After the implementation of the new government's organizational chart, cultural associations such as the Instituto Historico de Angra began to emerge. / Um ano depois do 25 de abril, a autonomia chegava aos Açores, uma regiao com uma identidade patrimonial muito propria. Apos a implementaçao do organigrama de um novo governo, começam a surgir as associações culturais como o Instituto Historico de Angra.

programme.title: Serengueti / Serengueti
programme.desc: Life happens in the Serengeti on an unprecedented scale. It is home to most of Africa's most iconic animals and hosts one of the world's biggest natural events: the annual wildebeest migration. / A vida acontece no Serengueti numa escala sem precedentes. É o lar da maioria dos animais mais emblemáticos de África e e palco de um dos maiores eventos naturais do mundo: a migraçao anual dos gnus.

programme.desc: In Broom, a small village with a strong rescue team, there are always accidents and problems such as a car crashing into a ravine on a rainy day, a child locked in a house, among other dangerous situations. In each episode, the village's rescue team saves some of the inhabitants. / Em Broom, uma pequena vila com uma forte equipa de resgate, existem sempre acidentes e problemas como um carro que se despista numa ravina num dia de chuva, uma criança fechada numa casa, entre outras situações de perigo. Em cada episodio, a equipa de resgate da vila salva alguns dos habitantes.

programme.title: Bing / Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny is a series based on children's books by author and illustrator Ted Dewan. It celebrates the realities, learning and adventure of being a preschooler when life is full of everyday dramas for both children and adults. / Bing Bunny e uma serie baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pre-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: Ana Ladina / Ana Ladina
programme.desc: Ana Ladina is a very mischievous and mischievous 5-year-old girl who finds it really fun to look for Ladina solutions for her daily adventures, sometimes surprising, but always fun! / Ana Ladina e uma menina de 5 anos, muito traquinas e marota que acha muito divertido procurar soluções ladinas para as suas aventuras diárias, por vezes surpreendentes, mas sempre divertidas!

programme.title: Gus the Minorca Knight / Gus, o Cavaleiro Minorca
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a little boy, Gus, who wanted to be a great knight. Sorry, not a great knight... The greatest knight in the entire kingdom of Karamel. The problem is that Gus is... minorca! He's three apples tall, but he has a heart the size of a house! / Era uma vez um rapazinho, Gus, que queria ser um grande cavaleiro. Desculpem, nao um grande cavaleiro... O maior cavaleiro de todo o reino de Karamel. O problema e que Gus e... minorca! Ele tem tres maças de altura, mas tem um coraçao do tamanho de uma casa!

programme.title: Petit / Petit
programme.desc: Discover Petit's unique and imaginative perspective on everyday situations that become fantastic adventures that he will live together with his friends. Based on the award-winning book "Petit El Monstruo" by Isol. / Descubra a perspetiva única e imaginativa de Petit sobre situações do quotidiano que se tornam aventuras fantásticas que ele irá viver, juntamente com os seus amigos. Baseado no premiado livro "Petit El Monstruo" de Isol.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings / Grizzy e os Lemingues
programme.desc: Grizzy the bear and the most brainless family ever, the Lemmings, are back for new, bumpy and fun adventures! / Grizzy, o urso, e a família mais desmiolada de sempre, os Lemingues, estao de volta para novas, atribuladas e divertidas aventuras!

programme.title: Always Late / Sempre Atrasados

programme.title: My Faith in Sport / My Faith in Sport
programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? programme.title: M3-ATP 250 - European open 2025 - Brussels / M3-ATP 250 - European open 2025 - Brussels
programme.desc: ATP 250 European Open 2025 (10th edition) debuts in Brussels after nine years in Antwerp, staged on indoor-hard courts at Brussels Expo (Palais 12), 13–19 Oct. Draw sizes: 28-player singles / 16-team doubles. Prize money: €706,850. Expect fast, first-strike tennis, sharp returns and tie-break pressure as contenders fight for late-season ranking points and momentum toward Turin. / ATP 250 European Open 2025 (10th edition) debuts in Brussels after nine years in Antwerp, staged on indoor-hard courts at Brussels Expo (Palais 12), 13–19 Oct. Draw sizes: 28-player singles / 16-team doubles. Prize money: €706,850. Expect fast, first-strike tennis, sharp returns and tie-break pressure as contenders fight for late-season ranking points and momentum toward Turin.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 10 / MMA UFC 10
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Illyria - Zadar / Košarka - ABA liga: Ilirija - Zadar
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Ephesus - Merkezefendi / Košarka - Turska liga: Efes - Merkezefendi
programme.desc: The beginnings of the Turkish basketball dwell back before the League founding in 1966. years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams playing each with every twice in the regular part after which the plejof is the eight best teams. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Germany League: Bayern - Bamberg / Košarka - Nemačka liga: Bayern - Bamberg
programme.desc: The history of the German club basketball dates back to 1939. years, but the German basketball Bundesliga was founded in 1964. while only the competition sets two years later. The competition consists of 18 teams, and the season is divided into the regular part where everyone plays with each two-circuit and the Plejof section that steps after completing the regular part. The last two of the regular part of the regular part drop out in the lower rank, while the Plejofor gets the Best of Five format where the teams must receive minimum 3 matches from 5 to eject the rivals. The interestingness of the league is that each team must have a hall of a minimum of 3000 places for the audience. / Istorija nemačke klupske košarke datira još iz 1939. godine, no Nemačka košarkaška Bundesliga osnovana je 1964. godine dok samo takmičenje je krenulo dve godine kasnije. Takmičenje se sastoji od 18 timova, a sezona je podeljena na regularni deo u kojem svako igra sa svakim dvokružno i plejof deo koji stupa nakon završenog regularnog dela. Poslednje dve ekipe regularnog dela ispadaju u niži rang, dok se u plejofu pobednik dobija Best of five formatu gdje ekipe moraju dobiti minmalno 3 utakmice od 5 kako bi izbacili rivala. Zanimljivost lige je da svaka ekipa mora imati dvoranu od minimalno 3000 mesta za publiku.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Real Madrid - Asvel / Košarka - Euroleague: Real Madrid - Asvel
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Krka - Cluj / Košarka - ABA liga: Krka - Cluj
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Posušje - Široki Brijeg / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Posušje - Široki Brijeg
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: They live for football / Oni žive za fudbal
programme.desc: The show for all lovers of this sport, which are fed up with industrial, high-cost football, for those who are a lot of tacticals and games without goals. The show will follow the matches played in the third rank of the football competition in Serbia. Every week we will present one match from all four groups of Serbian leagues, we will hear interesting interviews and see interesting attachments. / Emisija za sve ljubitelje ovog sporta, koji su se zasitili industrijskog, visokobudžetnog fudbala, za one kojima je dosta taktiziranja i utakmica bez golova. Emisija će pratiti utakmice koje se igraju u trećem rangu fudbalskog takmičenja u Srbiji. Svake nedelje predstavićemo po jednu utakmicu iz sve četiri grupe srpske lige, čućemo zanimljive intervjue i videti interesantne priloge.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Sarajevo - Zrinjski / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Sarajevo - Zrinjski
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. programme.sub-title: Ambienti; V bližini Olimja se s čudovitim razgledom ponašajo lične lesene hiške, ki se s svojo zasnovo navezujejo na kozjansko tradicijo. Njihova končna podoba je zasluga srčnih lastnikov z veliko občutka za estetiko.
programme.desc: The spirits on the facades returns to architecture as aesthetic and sustainable solution - especially since it offers natural chemicals without chemicals while creating a rustic and elegant look. Especially in the Gorenjska region, farmers used to burn wooden buildings intentionally to protect them from weather and pests. Architects followed the materiality of riparian objects in this part of Slovenia at the renovation of the boatmill on the western edge of Lake Bled. In the charming village above Litija, we visited the Green Paradise, which impresses with more than 2000 varieties of plants from around the world. It extends on a half -hectaric hectare of carefully entrenched terrain, where you will find an instructive walk between magnificent trees and shrubs and a stunning view of the surrounding hills. / Žgani les na fasadah se vrača v arhitekturo kot estetska in trajnostna rešitev – še posebej , ker ponuja naravno zaščito brez kemikalij, hkrati pa ustvarja rustikalen in eleganten videz. Predvsem na Gorenjskem, so kmetje nekoč lesene objekte namerno ožgali, da bi jih zaščitili pred vremenskimi vplivi in škodljivci. Arhitekti so pri prenovi čolnarne na zahodnem robu Blejskega jezera sledili materialnosti obrežnih objektov v tem delu Slovenije. V očarljivi vasici nad Litijo smo obiskali Zeleni raj, ki navdušuje z več kot 2000 sortami rastlin z vsega sveta. Razprostira se na poldrugem hektarju skrbno utrjenega strmega terena, kjer vas čaka poučen sprehod med veličastnimi drevesi in grmovnicami ter osupljiv razgled na okoliške hribe.

programme.sub-title: Asia; Dokumentarna serija Azija raziskuje izjemno naravo in naravna čudesa največje celine na Zemlji. Popelje nas skozi najosupljivejše azijske pokrajine – od najvišjih vrhov sveta v Himalaji do džungel Bornea, od polarne divjine Sibirije do koralnih mo
programme.desc: Part 2: Above the cloudsis is the most mountainous continent in the world. Asian mountains - from the forested mountainous areas of the tropical lane to the non -existent highs of the Himalayas - are a home of a stunning number of specially adapted plants and animals. In India, elephants live on highland tea plantations, and in Thailand the mountain caves are the largest gathering place for torrents on Earth. In Pakistan, the Vijeroga goat on steep cliffs deals with females, and in Nepal, the forested foot of the Himalayas gives the shelter of one of the most timid Asian mammals. Asia / UK / 2024 / Director: Sara Douglas. / 2. del: Nad oblakiAzija je najbolj gorata celina na svetu. Azijske gore – vse od gozdnatih gorskih območij tropskega pasu do negostoljubnih višav Himalaje – so dom osupljivega števila posebej prilagojenih rastlin in živali. V Indiji na visokogorskih čajnih plantažah živijo sloni, na Tajskem pa so gorske jame največje zbirališče hudournikov na Zemlji. V Pakistanu se vijerogi kozli na strmih pečinah spopadajo za samice, v Nepalu pa gozdnato vznožje Himalaje daje zavetje enemu najbolj plahih azijskih sesalcev. ASIA / Velika Britanija / 2024 / Režija: Sara Douglas.

programme.title: Head Upright - Magnificent History of the Blue Tablet: Hard Lessions, British Documentary Series, 1/2, Mon. / Glavo pokonci – veličastna zgodovina modre tabletke: Trda spoznanja, britanska dokumentarna serija, 1/2, pon.
programme.sub-title: Keeping It Up; Dokumentarna serija prikazuje odkritje in razvoj viagre, prve tablete za zdravljenje motnje erekcije, ki je pred četrt stoletja po mnenju mnogih povzročila drugo spolno revolucijo, primerljivo z iznajdbo kontracepcijskih tablet. Farmacevt
programme.desc: Part 1: A hard -learning early 90s. British experts from the Pfizer Pharmaceutical Company tested a new medicine for heart disease on the Wales Volunteer Group. Most men who took him reported an unexpected side effect: frequent erections. Research has shown that this substance could be treated with impotence. However, because the word had a worse tone, it was renamed to erectile. Critics accuse Pfizer that he recommended taking a pill to all men who are not entirely satisfied with their sex life. In the pharmaceutical company, however, they defend that they only wanted to help with the viagra and that they even received the Vatican approval before the sale in 1998.Keeping It Up / UK / 2023 / Director: Stephen Bennett. / 1. del: Trda spoznanjaNa začetku 90. let prejšnjega stoletja so britanski strokovnjaki iz farmacevtske družbe Pfizer na skupini prostovoljcev iz Walesa preizkušali novo zdravilo za srčne bolezni. Večina moških, ki so ga jemali, je poročala o nepričakovanem stranskem učinku: pogostih erekcijah. Raziskave so pokazale, da bi s to učinkovino lahko zdravili impotenco. Ker pa je imela beseda slabšalni prizvok, so jo preimenovali v motnjo erekcije. Kritiki Pfizerju očitajo, da je priporočal jemanje tabletke vsem moškim, ki niso povsem zadovoljni s svojim spolnim življenjem. V farmacevtski družbi pa se branijo, da so z viagro želeli le pripomoči k trdnejšim zakonskim zvezam in da so pred začetkom prodaje leta 1998 dobili celo odobritev Vatikana.KEEPING IT UP / Velika Britanija / 2023 / Režija: Stephen Bennett.

programme.title: Good morning, Mon. / Dobro jutro, pon.
programme.desc: Start the week with Good Morning! After reviewing the daily press and the current events, before the eighth, we tell you what kind of weather is waiting for us and what is written in the stars. In the "Myths and Truths" section, we explore and look for answers to eternal dilemmas and claims, and experts explain and argue them. The field team is always on standby and hunt for good stories in the center and around the capital. Monday is also marked by health minutes. In the Health section, according to reports at eight, we host UKC LJ specialists who advise and help remotely. At the home pharmacy with herbalists, aromatherapists, nutritionists, we present natural solutions for everyday problems. Monday's mornings are also a linguistic corner and a section or podcast woman, where special and different female representatives are presented. Monday morning, they round out the morning slide with young and promising singing talents and well -known couples, where we host recognizable media doubles. / Začnite teden z oddajo Dobro jutro! Po pregledu dnevnega tiska in aktualnega dogajanja vam še pred osmo povemo, kakšno vreme nas čaka in kaj je zapisano v zvezdah. V rubriki »Miti in resnice« raziskujemo in iščemo odgovore na večne dileme in trditve, strokovnjaki pa jih pojasnijo in argumentirajo. Terenska ekipa je vedno v pripravljenosti in na lovu za dobrimi zgodbami v centru in okolici glavnega mesta. Ponedeljek je tudi v znamenju zdravstvenih minut. V rubriki Zdravje, po poročilih ob osmih, gostimo specialiste UKC LJ, ki svetujejo in pomagajo na daljavo. V Domači lekarni z zeliščarji, aromaterapevti, nutricisti predstavljamo naravne rešitve za vsakodnevne težave. Stalnici ponedeljkovih juter sta tudi Jezikovni kotiček ter rubrika oziroma podkast Ženska, kjer predstavimo posebne in drugačne predstavnice ženskega spola. Ponedeljkova jutra zaokrožijo Jutranji tobogan z mladimi in perspektivnimi pevskimi talenti ter Znani pari, kjer gostimo prepoznavne medijske zakonske dvojice.

programme.title: In the garden, educational -events, Mon. / Na vrtu, izobraževalno–svetovalna oddaja, pon.
programme.desc: In Slovenia, tombstones are arranged as decorative billets, the only difference is that we use more rocks in tombstones. We monitor the sample tombstones of the Maribor Flower Shop. Six larger and two smaller billets were first arranged in mid -May. To check how the plants transferred the summer conditions, we looked at them in early August. Refreshed plantations of the tombstone (part 2) with seasonal flowers and summer flowering perennials planted tombstones have recently undergone a transformation: they have been transformed into autumn. Some plants had to be discarded, others were retained and planted by autumn more and lesser known beauties. The nest in the balcony Coincidance was discovered on Facebook by Mrs. Darija from Škofja Loka. Its flower balcony trough became home to five young promoters. The story of a boundless affection between man and bites has moved us a lot, so we decided to present it in the show. We believe the bird feeder that the garden is not beautiful, if there is no life on it, Sebastian Lipar has already made a simple bird feeder. You need two floral pedestals, a screw with ear, moss, wire and bird seeds. / V Sloveniji nagrobne nasade urejamo kot okrasne gredice, razlika je le v tem, da pri nagrobnih zasaditvah uporabljamo več kamenja. Spremljamo vzorčne nagrobne nasade cvetličarne Pogrebnega podjetja Maribor. Šest večjih in dve manjši gredici so prvič uredili sredi maja. Da bi preverili, kako so rastline prenesle poletne razmere, smo si jih ogledali v začetku avgusta. OSVEŽENI NASADI NAGROBNI GRED (2. del)S sezonskim cvetjem in poleti cvetočim trajnicam zasajene nagrobne grede so nedavno doživele preobrazbo: spremenili so jih v jesenske. Nekaj rastlin je bilo treba zavreči, druge so obdržali in dosadili jesenske bolj in manj znane lepotice. GNEZDO V BALKONSKEM KORITUPo naključju smo na facebooku odkrili zgodbo gospe Darije iz Škofje Loke. Njeno cvetlično balkonsko korito je postalo dom petim mladim postovkam. Zgodba o brezmejni naklonjenosti med človekom in ujedami nas je zelo ganila, zato smo odločili, da jo predstavimo tudi v oddaji. PTIČJA KRMILNICAKer verjamemo, da ni vrt ni lep, če na njem ni življenja, je Sebastjan Lipar že naredil preprosto ptičjo krmilnico. Potrebujete dva cvetlična podstavka, vijaka z ušesom, mah, žico in semena za ptice.

programme.title: Masera, village under Matajur, documentary, Mon. / Mašera, vas pod Matajurjem, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.desc: Just below Matajur, considered the Holy Mountain of the Venetian Slovenes, we visited the village of Masera, where the host, Luisa Battistig took us through the history of the village. In three museum collections, we can learn about the history of life in the village once. In the first, the objects that the locals used daily are exhibited. In blacksmithing we can see the blacksmith's tool left behind by Michele, Miha Dus. In the adjacent house, however, today he is stirred by the imagination of visitors "Uelbana Kljet", a vaulted cellar and a stone table in the middle of it. / Tik pod Matajurjem, ki velja za sveto goro Beneških Slovencev, smo obiskali vas Mašera, kjer nas je domačinka, Luisa Battistig popeljala skozi zgodovino vasi. V treh muzejskih zbirkah lahko spoznamo zgodovino življenja v vasi nekoč. V prvi so razstavljeni predmeti, ki so jih domačini uporabljali vsak dan. V kovačiji si lahko ogledamo kovaško orodje, ki ga je pustil za seboj zadnji kovač Michele, Miha Dus. V sosednji hiši pa še danes buri domišljijo obiskovalcev »uelbana kljet«, obokana klet in kamnita miza, ki stoji sredi nje.

programme.title: Caretaker Krause - there must be order / Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein

programme.title: Night of play / Nit de jocs

programme.title: Stories / Storie
programme.desc: The story of two young people and kindred spirits, leading a queer collective. In a Ticino still closed to the LGBTQIA+ scene, the two carry out a small but intense revolution, made up of DJ sets, performances and acts of daily resistance. Inspired by the cities in which they lived, Buenos Aires and London, they try to transform the reality that surrounds them, bringing the radical energy of the queer metropolises to the heart of Italian Switzerland. The film accompanies them in a crucial moment: the discovery of themselves, the beginning of new loves and the organization of a great event to celebrate the first year of the collective. A dream that collides with economic barriers and prejudices. Dolls on the Block is the intimate and vital portrait of a generation that fights to be seen, between shared dreams and the search for a space to exist. In a historical moment marked by the re-emergence of repressive policies and hate campaigns against the queer community, their commitment takes on an even more urgent force. A documentary by Patrik Soergel For further information we refer you to the following support sites: www.lgbtiq-helpline.ch/it puntodicontattoticino.wordpress.com / La storia di due giovani e anime affini, alla guida di un collettivo queer. In un Ticino ancora chiuso verso la scena LGBTQIA+, lə due portano avanti una piccola ma intensa rivoluzione, fatta di DJ set, performance e atti di resistenza quotidiana. Ispiratə dalle città in cui hanno vissuto, Buenos Aires e Londra, provano a trasformare la realtà che lə circonda, portando nel cuore della Svizzera italiana l’energia radicale delle metropoli queer.Il film lə accompagna in un momento cruciale: la scoperta di se, l’inizio di nuovi amori e l’organizzazione di un grande evento per celebrare il primo anno del collettivo. Un sogno che si scontra con barriere economiche e pregiudizi.Dolls on the Block è il ritratto intimo e vitale di una generazione che lotta per essere vista, tra sogni condivisi e la ricerca di uno spazio dove esistere. In un momento storico segnato dal riemergere di politiche repressive e campagne d’odio contro la comunità queer, il loro impegno assume una forza ancora più urgente.Un documentario di Patrik SoergelPer maggiori informazioni vi rimandiamo ai seguenti siti di supporto: www.lgbtiq-helpline.ch/it puntidicontattoticino.wordpress.com

Arianne and Jessica's families have fun together and free their imaginations in the immense spaces of Canada in the sixth and penultimate episode of the series. / Sempre più indipendenti e sempre più a loro agio nella natura selvaggia gli eroi di Missione Yukon si sono sistemati in un nuovo accampamento sulle rive del fiume Hess. Dopo settimane di pioggia intensa possono finalmente dedicarsi a varie attività da cacciatori-raccoglitori, e apprendere antiche e straordinarie tecniche con laiuto di Kim, esperto della vita nei boschi. Le famiglie di Arianne e Jessica si divertono insieme e liberano la propria immaginazione negli immensi spazi del Canada nella sesta e penultima puntata della serie.

programme.title: Paganini / Paganini
programme.desc: Radiorchestra, Orchestra della Radiotelevisione Svizzera, Orchestra della Svizzera italiana are some of the names used over the years to indicate the only symphonic ensemble, stable, professional and with public functions that has ever existed in Italian Switzerland: the OSI - as it is commonly called today. The background against which the orchestra was born was that of the Lugano Belle Époque and the first stable musical ensemble was the little orchestra set up by the Kursaal SA company and the Hoteliers Society with the precise aim of providing the entertainment desired by tourists of Germanic culture. In 1933 the newly formed national radio organization partially took over - acquiring some services from the orchestra for its own radio programs - and in 1935 the transformation was completed, with the official birth of the Radioorchestra. Paganini celebrates - in his episode on Sunday 12 October, from 10.30 on RSI LA1 - the 90th anniversary of the Orchestra della Svizzera italiana, underlining its "internal" origins at RSI. On the one hand with two historic television productions: Symphony no. 3 Scozzese by Felix Mendelssohn conducted by Riccardo Chailly (in 1979, for a studio recording without an audience) and the Four Maritime Interludes from Peter Grimes by Benjamin Britten, conducted by Neville Marriner at the Primavera concertistica in Lugano in 1999. On the other hand, the homage delves into the historical significance of the "radio orchestras" thanks to the recent - and at times truly exciting - documentary by Magdalena Zieba-Schwind entitled 100 Years of Radio Orchestras. - Symphony no. 3 "Scottish" by Mendelssohn - 100 years of radio orchestras - Neville Marriner conducts the OSI / Radiorchestra, Orchestra della Radiotelevisione Svizzera, Orchestra della Svizzera italiana sono alcuni dei nomi utilizzati nel corso degli anni per indicare lunico ensemble sinfonico, stabile, professionistico e con funzioni pubbliche che sia mai esistito nella Svizzera italiana: lOSI - come oggi viene comunemente chiamata. Lo sfondo su cui lorchestra nacque è quello della Lugano Belle Époque e il primo ensemble musicale stabile fu proprio lorchestrina allestita dalla società Kursaal SA e dalla Società degli Albergatori col preciso scopo di fornire lintrattenimento desiderato dai turisti di cultura germanica. Nel 1933 subentrò parzialmente il neonato ente radiofonico nazionale - acquisendo alcuni servizi dallorchestra per i propri programmi radio - e nel 1935 si completò la trasformazione, con la nascita ufficiale della Radiorchestra. Paganini festeggia - nella sua puntata di domenica 12 ottobre, dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1 - i 90 anni dellOrchestra della Svizzera italiana sottolineandone le origini "interne" alla RSI. Da un lato con due storiche produzioni televisive: la Sinfonia n. 3 Scozzese di Felix Mendelssohn diretta da Riccardo Chailly (nel 1979, per una registrazione in studio senza pubblico) e i Quattro interludi marini da Peter Grimes di Benjamin Britten, diretti da Neville Marriner alla Primavera concertistica di Lugano del 1999. Dallaltro lato, lomaggio va ad approfondire il significato storico delle "orchestre radiofoniche" grazie al recente - e a tratti davvero appassionante - documentario di Magdalena Zieba-Schwind intitolato I 100 anni delle orchestre radiofoniche. - La Sinfonia n. 3 "Scozzese" di Mendelssohn - I 100 anni delle orchestre radiofoniche - Neville Marriner dirige lOSI
